jobs.title: Tender Manager
jobs.description:
Do you want to take ownership of how tenders are won, rather than simply contributing to them?

Valcon is looking for an experienced Bid Manager to take the lead across the entire bid and tender process. From identifying and qualifying opportunities to defining the strategy, coordinating decision-making, managing stakeholders, safeguarding quality and evaluating results. The primary focus will be on European public tenders.

This is explicitly not a traditional bid writing role. Rather than spending your days writing proposals yourself, you ensure that the right people deliver the strongest possible content at the right time. You create structure, challenge subject-matter experts, safeguard the strategy and quality, and keep stakeholders aligned throughout the process. But in case of emergency it is important for you to also be able to write a tender yourself, which occasionally will happen.

The principle is simple: don’t write it yourself – enable the team to write it better.

What will you do?

As Bid Manager, you will be responsible for the end-to-end management of bids and tenders. You will oversee the full tender pipeline and take the lead on complex bid processes involving multiple disciplines, seniority levels and stakeholder interests.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Centrally identifying, qualifying and prioritising relevant tenders and commercial opportunities;
  • Organising and facilitating Go/No-Go decisions and according to the required approval process;
  • Developing and safeguarding the bid strategy;
  • Translating it into a clear plan and structured tender process;
  • Independently leading multidisciplinary bid teams consisting of partners, managers, consultants, subject matter experts and in some cases external stakeholders;
  • Managing timelines, progress, compliance and quality throughout the entire bid process;
  • Organising reviews and critically assessing contributions before submission;
  • Safeguarding legal and procedural requirements, particularly for European public tenders;
  • Reporting on the tender pipeline, results and performance to the CRO;
  • Evaluating completed bids and systematically translating lessons learned into improvements;
  • Further developing governance, processes, tooling, knowledge management and reporting within the Tender Desk;
  • Using data, technology and AI to make the bid process smarter, more efficient and more effective;
  • Training and coaching colleagues who contribute to bids and helping to increase bid management maturity across the organisation;
  • In case of emergency, it is important to also be able to write tenders yourself.

As Bid Manager, you ensure that the overall process works: that the right people contribute, deadlines are met, decisions are made and strategy, quality and content come together.

You are a Bid Manager, not a Bid Writer

That distinction is important.

At Valcon, consultants, partners and subject-matter experts provide the content and contribute to the actual writing of bids. Some colleagues will be specifically trained to participate regularly in tender processes, while others may have limited experience with public tenders.

Your role is not to take over their writing. Instead, you ensure the team understands what is required, why it matters and when it needs to be delivered.

You are therefore a project manager, strategist, quality gatekeeper and challenger at the same time.

You are comfortable challenging an experienced consultant or partner when their contribution is not yet strong enough. You ask the right questions, keep the team focused on the agreed strategy and know how to create momentum without relying on formal authority.

Strong stakeholder management is therefore essential. You need to be able to lead complex projects and influence senior stakeholders, partners and consultants across the organisation.

Building the Tender Desk

In addition to managing individual bids, you will have another important responsibility: further professionalising Tender Management within Valcon.

A foundation is being created, but the way of working is still developing. This means you are not stepping into a fully established function where everything has already been defined.

Instead, you will have the opportunity to further shape the processes, standards, governance, tooling and knowledge-sharing structure behind successful tender management.

A modern approach to Bid Management is essential. Valcon aims to integrate data and AI into the bid process and is looking for someone who actively embraces these developments. You understand how technology can support opportunity identification, knowledge management, collaboration, quality and efficiency, and you are keen to explore how AI can become an integral part of the bid management process.

What do we offer you?

  • Personal development: a tailor-made growth path with training, courses, certification and mentoring by experienced colleagues.
  • An innovative work environment: collaborate with a team of experts pushing boundaries in data, technology, and consulting.
  • Inspiring work culture: a supportive, flexible, and no-nonsense environment that fosters your growth and fully allows you to be yourself.

Additionally, we offer:

  • Competitive employment benefits, including bonuses and expense allowance.
  • A company car or mobility budget.
  • A workplace that prioritizes and respects your work-life balance (for example by offering you the option of taking a sabbatical or expand the amount of holidays per year).
  • An affordable sports membership that allows you to participate in 50 different sports offered by over 10,000 partners.
  • The opportunity to work remotely from abroad for 10 days per year.
  • A vibrant community that organizes both professional and social events.

What do you bring to the table?

You are an experienced bid or tender management professional who is ready for a role in which strategy, leadership and coordination carry more weight than writing proposals yourself.

Ideally, you bring:

  • A demonstrable track record of contributing to successful bids and winning significant opportunities.
  • Significant experience in Bid Management and/or Tender Management within a complex professional environment;
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to create structure, organise decision-making and manage multiple workstreams and deadlines;
  • Strong senior stakeholder management skills and the ability to influence without formal authority;
  • The ability to assess tenders and commercial opportunities from a strategic and commercial perspective;
  • Experience within consulting, professional services or another knowledge-intensive environment is a strong advantage;
  • Affinity with data, AI and modern bid management tooling;
  • Experience coaching colleagues and helping teams adopt new ways of working;

Who are you?

You have the seniority and confidence to take the lead while still knowing how to bring people with you.

You can move comfortably between strategic discussions and operational delivery and thrive in an environment with senior professionals who each bring their own expertise, priorities and perspectives to a bid.

You are analytical and commercially minded, but also pragmatic. You ask challenging questions, make decisions when needed and are comfortable questioning whether the quality of a tender is genuinely good enough.

At the same time, you enjoy building and developing: teams, processes and a Bid Management capability that is still evolving.

Ready to apply?

Has the above sparked your interest and are you ready to join our innovative and impactful environment? And do our core values - Together, Joy, Curious, Can do, and Integrity - resonate with you?

Our recruitment team would be happy to hear from you! Please apply directly or get in touch with our recruitment team ----- to schedule a coffee meeting at our office first.

jobs.title: Physician Assistant of Verpleegkundig Specialist
jobs.description:
Wat ga je doen?

Bij Cardiologie Centra Nederland, locatie Dokkum draai je zelfstandig spreekuur en ben je medisch inhoudelijk verantwoordelijk voor je eigen patiëntenpopulatie. Je stelt zelfstandig diagnose- en behandelplannen op, verricht risicostratificatie en begeleidt patiënten met uiteenlopende, complexe cardiologische beelden, zoals:

  • Pijn op de borst (angina pectoris) en ischemische hartziekten;
  • Hartritmestoornissen (o.a. atriumfibrilleren);
  • Hartfalen, hypertensie en hypercholesterolemie;
  • Hartkleplijden.

Je combineert medisch-technische zorg met leefstijlgeneeskunde en langdurige opvolging. Waar nodig spar je op gelijkwaardige basis met de aanwezige cardiologen; de lijnen zijn bij ons kort en de sfeer is collegiaal. En omdat de inzet van een PA of VS bij onze locatie in Dokkum nieuw is, bieden we een kans: jij bouwt actief mee aan de vormgeving van deze rol en de polikliniek. Jouw visie, klinische blik en initiatief zijn hierin leidend.

De locatie in Dokkum is gevestigd binnen het Sionsberg Netwerk Ziekenhuis. Je komt te werken in een toegankelijk en informeel team, waarin we echt voor elkaar klaarstaan. Bovendien biedt het werken in Dokkum rust en ruimte: gratis parkeren voor de deur, geen files en een prachtige omgeving. Bij CCN denken we mee over jouw ontwikkeling. Mocht jij jouw werk bijvoorbeeld op de cardiologie willen afwisselen met ervaring binnen bijvoorbeeld de traumatologie. Dan is dit zeker bespreekbaar na de opstart van deze nieuwe rol binnen onze poli cardiologie.

Over ons: onze zorg klopt!

We zijn een organisatie van zelfstandige behandelcentra voor hart- en vaatziekten die zich onderscheidt door poliklinische zorg perfect af te stemmen op de behoeften van de patiënt en de verwijzer. We geloven in de kracht van complete zorg onder één dak. Onze patiënten kunnen dicht bij huis terecht voor de meest hoogwaardige cardiologische zorg, en jij speelt daarin een belangrijke rol.

We werken met geavanceerde hartritme-analyses (holtermonitoring), begeleiden patiënten op afstand via ons innovatieve e-health programma Hartwacht, en voeren poliklinisch elektrische cardioversies (ECV’s) uit. Met een eigen PM-technicus én een eigen spoedpolikliniek in huis is de dynamiek hoog.

Daarnaast beschikken we binnenkort over onze eigen CT coronairen. Met deze modernste apparatuur brengen we lokaal, snel en non-invasief de kransslagaders in beeld, een fantastische kwaliteitsimpuls voor jouw diagnostische werk.

Wie ben jij?

  • Je hebt de Master Physician Assistant (MPA) óf Master Advanced Nursing Practice (MANP) afgerond en beschikt over een geldige BIG-registratie;
  • Je hebt aantoonbare klinische ervaring binnen de cardiologie (of een zeer sterke affiniteit om je hier in te verdiepen);
  • Je bent communicatief sterk, werkt graag autonoom en zoekt de samenwerking op.

Wat bieden we jou?

Bij CCN krijg je een salaris conform CAO Zelfstandige Klinieken Nederland (ZKN), een fulltime dienstverband bestaat uit een 40-urige werkweek. De CAO zorgt voor een aantrekkelijk pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden. We willen het beste voor jou, het team en de patiënt. Wij bieden je onder andere het volgende:

  • Een salaris tussen €5.295,- tot €7.901,- conform FWG 65 (cao ZKN) o.b.v. 40 uur per week. We schalen je in op basis van jouw ervaring;
  • Vakantiegeld (8,33%), een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33% en deelname aan de pensioenregeling bij PFZW;
  • Een jaarcontract voor 16-32 uur per week, met duidelijke intentie op een volgend contract voor onbepaalde tijd;
  • Een gezonde werk-privébalans: wij bieden uitsluitend regelmaat. Je draait dus géén diensten in de weekenden of avond/nacht;

jobs.title: Merchant Growth Specialist
jobs.description:
Make sure every restaurant on SOUS grows its revenue, across Uber Eats, Just Eat Takeaway and its own direct ordering channel.

Full-time

About SOUS

SOUS exists to give independent restaurants the same acquisition-to-retention infrastructure that only chains and delivery platforms could previously afford. We build it as one connected data layer, replacing the fragmented stack most restaurants run today: a listings tool here, a separate storefront there, and no CRM at all.

Spotlight owns discovery, as search shifts from Google links to AI assistants recommending where to eat. Commerce owns the transaction and, critically, the guest relationship that marketplaces have been extracting for a decade. Every order through that owned channel generates data that sharpens the next cycle of visibility, personalisation and retention, compounding in the restaurant's favour instead of the platform's.

Our long-term bet is simple. As AI becomes the default interface for "where should I eat", the restaurants that own their guest data and their presence in that layer will keep the margin, and the ones still renting both from marketplaces will not. We are building the infrastructure to make the first outcome the default, not the exception.

We are a team of 27, working from our headquarters on the Vijzelstraat in Amsterdam city centre, and we are growing fast across the Netherlands, Germany and South Africa.

About the role

Our promise to restaurants is simple: SOUS helps you grow. That means more visibility in AI search, more direct orders without commission, and a stronger performance on the delivery platforms restaurants already use. As our merchant base grows quickly, we want every single restaurant to see that growth in its numbers.

As Merchant Growth Specialist you make that promise real. You dive into each merchant's online performance, find the biggest opportunities and help them capture them. What you learn flows straight back into our product and playbooks.

Your team

You are part of the Growth team and work closely with the Growth Lead and our product team. You work hand in hand with Merchant Success, who own the day-to-day relationship with our merchants.

Tasks

Your focus

  • Drive measurable revenue growth for our merchants
  • Optimise merchant revenue on Uber Eats and Just Eat Takeaway
  • Grow the share of direct orders through SOUS Commerce and visibility through Spotlight
  • Turn what works into repeatable growth playbooks and product input

Key responsibilities

  • Audit merchants' online presence: menus, pricing, photos, listings and reviews
  • Optimise marketplace listings and promotions to lift revenue on delivery platforms
  • Help merchants move loyal guests to their own direct ordering channel
  • Monitor merchant performance data and act on opportunities and risks
  • Run growth experiments and campaigns for merchant groups
  • Share insights with the product team to shape new features
  • Work with Merchant Success to turn results into long-term customer relationships and success stories

Requirements

  • 3 to 4 years of experience in growth, account management, marketplace operations or e-commerce
  • A strong, hands-on understanding of food delivery platforms such as Uber Eats and Just Eat Takeaway: how their algorithms, promotions, fees and rankings work
  • Analytical and comfortable with data, spreadsheets and dashboards
  • A good understanding of how restaurants work and what drives their revenue
  • Fluent in Dutch and English

Benefits

  • Salary of €50,000 to €70,000 gross per year, depending on experience
  • 25 holiday days plus Dutch public holidays, and 8% holiday allowance
  • Working side by side with the team at our headquarters on the Vijzelstraat in Amsterdam city centre

jobs.title: Senior Reinforcement Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity 

We are looking for a Senior Reinforcement Learning Engineer to join our Motion Intelligence team. You should bring deep expertise in reinforcement learning and policy optimisation, grounded in real-world robotics experience, and be excited to push the boundaries of autonomous robots. We are looking for someone who can provide senior-level RL and learning-based control guidance across the team — shaping how we train, deploy, and maintain learned policies on physical robots operating in demanding industrial environments.
Beyond RL expertise, we value engineers who take pride in writing clean, maintainable code, simplifying complex systems through thoughtful design, and championing sound interfaces and architecture.

At ANYbotics, we develop tailored software solutions that enable our legged robots to execute inspection and maintenance tasks with precision and consistency. This role sits at the intersection of cutting-edge RL research and production robotics — from sim-to-real policy transfer and reward engineering through to reliable deployment on mission-critical systems in the field. You’ll work across the full lifecycle — from early development prototyping through to mission‑critical, production deployments.

 
The Market & Our Technology 

ANYbotics transforms industrial plants in the energy, process, and utility sector by introducing robotics to a wide range of novel applications that so far were beyond reach. Our customers are large asset operators and industrial service providers pioneering the use of robotics technology for inspection and maintenance. Our mobile robot ANYmal uses legs for extreme mobility in complex environments, camera- and LIDAR-based sensing for full autonomy and obstacle avoidance, and AI for high-quality and consistent inspection results. We develop numerous customised hardware systems, including the entire robotic platform, actuators, sensors, inspection payloads, charging systems, and all related ANYbotics electrical hardware.


Your Impact
  • Lead the design, training, and deployment of reinforcement learning policies for robot motion — bridging the gap from simulation to reliable real-world performance
  • Provide senior technical guidance on RL and learning-based control across the team, mentoring engineers and establishing best practices for policy development workflows
  • Own and evolve the RL training infrastructure and sim-to-real pipeline, ensuring reproducibility, scalability, and fast iteration cycles
  • Shape the technical vision for internal ML tooling and experiment management (e.g. training dashboards, automated evaluation pipelines), driving efficiency and rigour across the team's learning workflows
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders to identify how to expand the robot's autonomous operational envelope
  • Triage field issues related to locomotion, recognise failure patterns, and rapidly improve policy robustness based on real deployment data
  • Write, deploy, and maintain efficient Python and C++ software for the learning and locomotion stack

    • Your Profile
  • PhD in robotics, machine learning, computer science or a related field with a strong focus on reinforcement learning; alternatively, an equivalent track record of RL research and deployment in robotics Or
  • Master's degree from a top-tier technical university (e.g. ETH Zurich, EPFL) in robotics, machine learning, computer science or related field and 5+ years of professional experience
  • Proven track record of shipping ML models to the field and maintaining those solutions over time
  • Solid grounding in robot control fundamentals and autonomous systems, including: motion control, state estimation, path planning and actuation
  • Experience using robotic simulation tools such as Gazebo or Isaac Sim
  • Strong understanding of sim-to-real transfer, domain randomisation, reward shaping, and policy robustness techniques
  • Proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks (PyTorch); working knowledge of C++
  • Strong knowledge of Linux systems and middleware frameworks for integrating learned components into a larger software stack
  • Pragmatic and solution-oriented mindset — comfortable balancing research exploration with production delivery
  • Excellent communication skills in English

    • Bonus Points
  • Experience training and deploying RL policies on physical robots — not just in simulation
  • Development of scalable and modular robot architectures of motion control systems
  • Experience with navigation systems and autonomous mobile robot operation in unstructured environments
  • Interest in agentic engineering toolchains
  • Experience leading software architecture design and software engineering best practices
  • A solid grasp of physical systems, specifically multibody dynamics, electromechanical drive physics, energy optimization, and contact physics, to ensure learned policies respect hardware limits and transfer successfully from simulation to the real world
    • We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich.

jobs.description:
SwissBorg is building the future of crypto wealth management, making investing more accessible, transparent and intuitive for everyone. At the core of our platform is the Meta-Exchange (MEX). This smart routing engine connects multiple exchanges and liquidity sources to deliver optimal execution in a single, seamless app.

We're Swiss-engineered, regulated, and trusted by nearly one million users managing over $1B in crypto assets. But beyond the numbers, what drives us is the people behind every wallet and a commitment to continuously improving how they experience and interact with crypto.


Join us!

Are you an Accountant with a strong technical foundation, ideally shaped in a Big 4 audit or accounting outsourcing team, looking for broad, hands-on responsibility in an international group? 

SwissBorg is a crypto wealth management platform operating through a group of regulated entities across Switzerland, France, Estonia and other jurisdictions. Our accounting team is small, and every member makes a real difference. In this role, you will own Accounts Payable and contribute across the full scope of the accounting function: month-end close, reconciliations, intercompany, VAT and tax, and audit preparation.

We would love to hear from you if you are a versatile all-rounder who enjoys the variety that comes with a multi-entity group. The ideal candidate can step into any part of the accounting cycle, from processing supplier invoices to preparing audit files. 


You will:

  • Own the Accounts Payable process: supplier invoice review and coding (ApprovalMax/Xero), payment preparation, supplier statement reconciliations and vendor master data

  • Prepare and manage general ledger entries, accruals and prepayments

  • Monthly, quarterly and annual closes for all group entities, in collaboration with external accounting firms

  • Balance sheet and bank reconciliations, and account analysis to ensure balances are correct and supported

  • Monthly intercompany reconciliations, recharges and settlements across group entities

  • Supporting VAT and other tax compliance across jurisdictions (VAT returns, reverse charge, withholding taxes), working with our external tax advisors

  • Prepare audit files and support the annual and interim audits of the group entities

  • Strengthen internal controls and improve accounting processes, contributing your own ideas

  • Manage both technical and routine accounting tasks with a high degree of accuracy and consistency


About you:

  • A degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field

  • Around 5 years of accounting experience, ideally starting at a Big 4 firm in audit or accounting outsourcing

  • A strong accounting background: confident with general ledger accounting, closing, reconciliations, accruals and the full accounting cycle

  • Experience with multi-entity groups, intercompany accounting and, ideally, consolidation

  • Hands-on Accounts Payable experience; experience coaching or reviewing the work of junior team members is a plus

  • Working knowledge of VAT and corporate tax compliance; international or cross-border VAT exposure is a plus

  • Experience preparing for and working with external auditors

  • Hands-on experience with accounting software and strong Excel skills; familiarity with Xero and ApprovalMax is a plus

  • Must have an interest in crypto and/or crypto accounting is a plus

  • Fluent English (French is a bonus)

  • A proactive, detail-oriented and independent working style, comfortable in a remote, international team

Who We Are:

We are a rapidly growing embodied AI company revolutionizing human labor. Leveraging cutting-edge robotics and advanced artificial intelligence, we develop transformative technologies that redefine how work is done across multiple industries—empowering businesses to streamline operations, boost productivity, and unlock new possibilities.

Overview:

We are looking for a world-class robotics professionals to join our R&D hub in the Zurich area. In this role, you will be at the forefront of developing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models that enable robots to understand and interact with the world with unprecedented generalization. You will work on the intersection of large-scale foundation models and real-world robotic execution, bridging the gap between state-of-the-art research and deployed embodied intelligence.

Your Responsibilities:

Research & Development:

  • Design, implement, and scale VLA models and foundation architectures for robotic manipulation and navigation.

Scaling Laws & Data:

  • Develop strategies for multi-modal data collection, synthetic data generation, and efficient fine-tuning of large-scale models.

Algorithm Optimization:

  • Optimize model inference for real-time robotic applications without compromising reasoning capabilities.

Publication & Visibility:

  • Contribute to the global research community by publishing high-impact papers at top-tier conferences (NeurIPS, CVPR, ICRA, CoRL, etc.).

Collaboration:

  • Work closely with the Core Robotics and Hardware teams to integrate AI models into our physical platforms.

Qualifications:

Academic Excellence:

  • PhD or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Robotics, or a related field, with a focus on Deep Learning and Computer Vision.

Proven Research Track Record:

  • Significant publications and citations at major conferences such as NeurIPS, CVPR, ICCV, ICRA, IROS, or CoRL.

Professional Background:

  • Experience working in leading AI research environments

Technical Mastery:

  • Deep expertise in PyTorch or JAX, experience with Transformers, Diffusion Models, and Large Language Models (LLMs).

Domain Knowledge:

  • Strong understanding of Vision-Language models and their application to Action/Control loops in robotics.

Location:

Zurich Area, Switzerland:

jobs.description:
Research Engineer, Manipulation Data & Teleoperation — Zurich

This role owns the data generation layer of Sereact's VLA stack: teleoperation systems and data collection infrastructure that feed Cortex, built from our Zurich research hub.

About Sereact

Sereact is a Series B embodied-AI company. Cortex, our VLA model, is deployed in live warehouse robotic cells across the EU and US. Zurich is our newest research hub, focused on the manipulation and control problems that sit underneath Cortex.

The role

This is a Research Engineer position. It is scoped to the data generation layer of the VLA stack: teleoperation hardware and software, retargeting pipelines that map human demonstrations onto robot hands, and the data collection infrastructure that feeds Cortex. It requires building the systems that produce the data those models train on, and working closely with the training team on what that data needs to look like.

What you'll do

  • Build and operate teleoperation systems for dexterous manipulation, including retargeting algorithms that map human hand and arm motion onto robot end-effectors

  • Design and maintain scalable, UMI-style data collection hardware and software that other engineers at Sereact rely on

  • Benchmark control and retargeting approaches using rigorous, human-factors-informed methodology

  • Instrument and support the physical robots deployed in the Zurich hub, including day-to-day work on the control stack

  • Work with the model-training team to define what data they need and close the loop on data quality

  • Build tooling or infrastructure outside your immediate brief when it unblocks the wider team

What you'll bring

  • MSc (or equivalent, in progress) in robotics, mechanical engineering, or a closely related field, with a thesis or capstone project on manipulation, teleoperation, or retargeting

  • Hands-on experience building a data collection device or system for robot learning (UMI or a comparable system), not just operating one someone else built

  • Working knowledge of retargeting algorithms for mapping human input onto robot hands or end-effectors

  • 1 to 2 years of combined research, internship, or industry experience in robotics, mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline

  • Software and systems engineering skills strong enough to build and maintain infrastructure other engineers rely on, not only research-grade prototypes

  • Comfortable working as an individual contributor in a small, still-forming team

Nice to have

  • A conference submission on manipulation, teleoperation, or retargeting where the candidate is an author (an MSc thesis submitted to a venue like CoRL counts; supervising a student team whose own work was later published does not)

  • Teaching or TA experience in a robotics course

  • Some exposure to large-model training, even without an independent training record

  • A concrete example of building something outside the formal role brief because the team needed it

Getlabs is the leading platform for at-home diagnostics.

 

Healthcare organizations use Getlabs to send mobile phlebotomists to patientsâ homes and collect labs, vitals, and advanced diagnostics. By leveraging Getlabs, partners can improve patient adherence and close gaps in care with same-day, nationwide availability.

 

Our team has raised $50M from strategic investors including the two largest diagnostic laboratories in the United States, Labcorp and Quest. Getlabsâ mission is to save lives by expanding access to diagnostics for everyone.


About the role: 

We are currently seeking a full-time Field Phlebotomy Supervisor interested in joining a high-growth stage startup. The mandate of the Field Phlebotomy Supervisor is simple but challenging: assist our Operations Manager with the day-to-day operations throughout the market and ensure our patients have the best experience possible.

 

The Field Phlebotomy Supervisor oversees the quality of territories patient operations. You will be responsible for ensuring that every Getlabs experience meets and exceeds the patient's expectations. You will also help train and ensure quality for our team of hourly phlebotomists.  Above all, we are seeking candidates who are self-starters and are resourceful, organized, detail-oriented, communicative, and friendly.

 

This position is currently limited to candidates residing within a one-hour commute of the San Francisco Bay Area. 

 

 

 

 

\n


At Getlabs, you will:
  • Supervise a team of mobile phlebotomists in one or more geographical markets
  • Assess work performance and perform appointment reviews for compliance, quality, and safety on a regular basis; accurately report all findings
  • Administer disciplinary action as appropriate
  • Interview and hire new mobile phlebotomists
  • Effectively and efficiently onboard new hires
  • Complete new hire and annual competency assessments for team
  • Ensure accurate order and patient appointment record-keeping 
  • Administer performance reviewsHandle employee concerns and grievances
  • Review daily/weekly schedules for team and make schedule adjustments as needed; organize, plan, and assign work
  • Plan and manage a budget
  • Assist with day-to-day customer service and manager-level escalations including interactions with patients via inbound calls, outbound calls, emails, and other communication platforms
  • Review and approve team timecards and expenses 


What we are looking for:
  • At least 2 years of management experience in a leadership position is required
  • Phlebotomy certification from an accredited agency is required: American Medical Technologists (AMT), American Society for Clinical Pathology (ASCP), or National Center for Competency Testing (NCCT) In-depth knowledge of phlebotomy duties, responsibilities and techniques a plus!
  • Proven track record in providing exceptional customer service
  • Strong communication skills; both written and verbal (Google suite a plus)
  • A disciplined worker who can work independently or in a team environment
  • Reliable transportation and clean driving record
  • Competency with Google applications and willingness to embrace new technology
  • A proven ability to handle ambiguity in the absence of defined systems and processes


We have great benefits to make your life easier so you can focus on what you're best at:

  • Flexible and unlimited vacation
  • A company with a huge vision, a dynamic work environment, and a team of talented, ambitious and fun to work-with colleagues!

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
Consequential Work. Dedicated People.


About Onebrief

Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.

Why This Role Exists

As a Solutions Engineer at Onebrief, you work where mission, engineering, and compliance meet.

You'll own technical solution design and deployment readiness, translating customer requirements into secure, scalable deployment architectures. You'll partner with Platform Engineering, SRE, and our Cybersecurity team to validate infrastructure, configure environments, resolve technical blockers, and successfully transition solutions into production.

Youâll work with our go-to-market and customer facing teams to meet with planners, operations officers, and network owners to understand how they work today. Youâll help show them what that work looks like in Onebrief, and then you'll make it real.

You connect a staff's planning problem to a live, accredited Onebrief deployment.

What You'll Do

Core responsibilities:

  • Run technical discovery. With Sales and Engineering, map a staff's current workflow and pain points, specifically focusing on their technical constraints: networks, hosting, identity, and integration requirements, especially in multi-network environments.

  • Lead deployment engineering. Coordinate the technical delivery of new deployments, including infrastructure validation, network configuration checks, and system readiness verification. Write code to configure new deployments and support new environments.

  • Support accreditation. Help create and review security documentation, including STIG checklists and ATO artifacts, alongside our cybersecurity team so deployments are accredited on the customer's timeline.

  • Align stakeholders. Get technical stakeholders on both sides to agree on requirements, constraints, and tradeoffs, so customers see value sooner. Ensure those technical requirements are properly translated into contract deliverables.

  • Scope integrations. Design how Onebrief Connect fits into a command's ecosystem: APIs, data pipelines, Foundry and Maven Smart System, CUOPS tools, and dashboards.

  • Deliver tailored demos. Lead technical demonstrations and solution validation, partnering with Sales and customer-facing teams to demonstrate Onebrief's technical capabilities, deployment architecture, security posture, and integration options.

  • Run pilot deployments. Configure Onebrief in new and untested environments to enable limited uses in support of new sales.

  • Turn field experience into patterns. Convert what you learn in deployments into structured workflows and reusable implementation patterns, and feed clear requirements to Product and Engineering.

  • Travel 30â50% of the time to customer sites and exercises.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility.

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • 4+ years in solutions engineering, infrastructure or deployment engineering, or forward-deployed engineering, working closely with go-to-market and operational teams

  • Experience in DoW environments and their security and compliance requirements (RMF, STIGs, ICD 503)

  • Strong expertise with containers (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes)

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and on-premises virtualization (RHEL)

  • Solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols, and of security best practices for highly sensitive environments

  • Strong presence with customers, from action officers to senior leaders, and clear, concise writing

  • Calm under pressure, and focused on forward motion

Preferred Qualifications

jobs.description:
Unser herzliches 4-Sterne Hotel in der vielfältigen Region Zell am See-Kaprun sucht eine engagierte 1 Front-Office-Mitarbeiter_in Eintritt nach Vereinbarung.

Gastgeber aus Leidenschaft? Dann passen wir vielleicht perfekt zusammen! Du hast Freude daran, Menschen willkommen zu heißen, bist gerne mittendrin statt nur dabei und behältst auch dann dein Lächeln, wenn es einmal etwas turbulenter wird?

Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen!

Für unser 4-Sterne-Hotel Sonnblick im Herzen von Kaprun suchen wir eine herzliche, motivierte Persönlichkeit, die unser Rezeptionsteam verstärkt. Bei uns geht es nicht nur um Check-ins, Reservierungen und Gästewünsche. Es geht darum, unseren Gästen vom ersten "Grüß Gott" bis zum Abschied ein richtig gutes Gefühl zu geben.

Und genauso wichtig ist uns, dass sich auch unsere Mitarbeiter bei uns wohlfühlen.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

* 5-Tage-Woche - denn Freizeit und Erholung gehören dazu

* Geregelte Arbeitszeiten für eine gute Planbarkeit

* Kostenlose Verpflegung - für dein leibliches Wohl ist gesorgt

* Kostenlose Unterkunft - damit du dich auch abseits der Arbeit wohlfühlst

* Ein familiäres, herzliches Arbeitsumfeld, in dem man sich gegenseitig unterstützt

* Ein abwechslungsreicher Arbeitsplatz mit Gästen aus aller Welt

* Arbeiten, wo andere Urlaub machen - mitten in der wunderschönen Bergwelt von Kaprun

Deine Aufgaben - abwechslungsreich und vielseitig

* Du begrüßt unsere Gäste herzlich und bist ihre erste Ansprechperson.

* Du kümmerst dich um Check-in, Check-out und die Gästebetreuung.

* Du bearbeitest Reservierungen, E-Mails und telefonische Anfragen.

* Du gibst unseren Gästen Tipps für einen unvergesslichen Aufenthalt in unserer Region.

* Du arbeitest eng mit deinen Kollegen aus den verschiedenen Abteilungen zusammen.

* Und vor allem: Du sorgst mit deiner Persönlichkeit dafür, dass sich unsere Gäste rundum willkommen fühlen.

Das wünschen wir uns von dir

* Du bist offen, freundlich und hast Freude am Umgang mit Menschen.

* Du arbeitest selbstständig, zuverlässig und behältst auch in lebhaften Momenten den Überblick.

In this role you will:

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement these features, empowering developers with a comprehensive suite of tools to build and deploy their applications efficiently.

Work closely with the SRE team to ensure high availability and minimal downtime. Enable our customers to seamlessly scale their applications to meet the demands of their growing user base.

Implement strategies to reduce cloud expenses without compromising performance or reliability. This could involve techniques such as resource provisioning, auto-scaling, cost-aware scheduling, and data lifecycle management. Your efforts will directly contribute to the financial efficiency of our cloud services.



Required skills and experience:

 - Distributed systems: Track record of working with platform-as-a-service, distributed storage, or information retrieval systems. Experience in designing scalable architectures and optimizing systems for latency or cost. 

 - Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach complex challenges pragmatically and devise effective solutions. You think radically but ship incrementally.

 - Self-directed and autonomous: Able to work independently, set priorities, and drive projects forward. You take ownership and initiative.

 - Versatility and flexibility: Able to wear multiple hats and tackle a wide range of challenges. You are comfortable working across different layers of the stack and adapting to the needs of the project.

 - Continuous learning and adaptability: Passionate about staying up-to-date with industry trends and expanding your skill set. You embrace change and adapt quickly.



Nice to have:

 - Experience working on cloud infrastructure or platform products, particularly in the areas of application deployment, serverless computing, or container orchestration.

 - Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services and tools, such as GCE, GKE,, Cloud Run, or Cloud Storage.

 - Contributions to open-source projects related to cloud technologies, deployment frameworks, or developer tools. We love OSS!

jobs.title: Outcomes Architect Manager
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As a first-line leader directly managing a team of Outcomes Architects, you’ll own your team’s execution across workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, expansion qualification, and at-risk account recovery — accountable for both the customer outcomes and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn’t a traditional Customer Success management role. The best OA Managers are coaches first: they know what great workflow discovery looks like, can review a mutual success plan and identify where value realization is breaking down, can inspect an executive business review and sharpen the value narrative, and can help an OA turn account activity into measurable customer and commercial outcomes.

You’ll run an inspection cadence and cultivate a coaching culture that make consistent execution possible across the team. You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultant leaders, Sales, Services, Support, Product, and RevOps to ensure customers move from workflow design to adoption, value realization, expansion, and renewal readiness.

If you’re a builder who loves developing people as much as driving customer impact — and you want to lead a team in a post-sales motion that’s being redefined for the AI era — this is the role.

 


WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE

 - Own the Net Revenue Growth performance of your team’s book of business, accountable for both headline outcomes and the quality of execution that drives workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, and expansion.

 - Coach OAs on the OA builder motion: AI Transformation Plans, build-beside workshops, value reviews, use-case consultations, and renewal processes.

 - Build and run the operating cadence for the team: metrics reviews, account support sessions, adoption and renewal-risk reviews, call coaching against the OA quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership.

 - Hire, onboard, and certify new OAs to the GTM builder motion, driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution and managing performance with clarity when expectations are not met.

 - Partner closely with Solutions Consultant managers and leaders on strategy for expansion and renewal across shared accounts, ensuring clear ownership for flat and at-risk renewals.

 - Partner with Services leadership to identify complex implementation needs early, create clear handoffs, and ensure Services delivery accelerates workflow adoption and measurable value.

 - Set the standard for product, AI, and workflow fluency across the team so OAs can help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion.

 - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down

 - Uphold excellence by coaching to the global OA methodology, quality rubric, and activity KPIs.
   
    


SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING

 - Frontline management experience leading customer-facing GTM teams in B2B software, ideally across Customer Success, Solutions Consulting, Technical Account Management, Professional Services, Account Management, or post-sales strategy.

 - Direct experience coaching teams through customer discovery, workflow design, adoption planning, value realization, renewals, expansion, or technical/workflow implementation.

 - Strong coaching orientation: you can review a customer call, account plan, mutual success plan, or executive value narrative and identify specifically what needs to change — not just whether the outcome was good, but why and how to improve it.

 - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read account health, renewal risk, adoption depth, expansion potential, and customer sentiment, then drive urgency without micromanaging every account.

 - Deep customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical adoption and implementation plans.

 - Experience operating in a shared account ownership model with Sales, Solutions, Services, Support, or Implementation teams.

 - Operational rigor: you know how to build inspection cadences, coaching rituals, performance standards, and accountability systems that improve execution across a team.

 - Ability to develop talent from onboarding through consistent performance, including hiring to profile, setting clear expectations, coaching skill gaps, and managing performance with clarity.

 - Executive communication skills: able to synthesize account patterns, customer risks, team performance, and cross-functional asks into clear signal for leadership.

 - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor. You do not need to build every workflow yourself, but you should be able to understand Notion systems, coach workflow design, and help your team troubleshoot adoption blockers.

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems.

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious, hands-on, and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter, coach better, and help customers deliver better outcomes.
   
    


NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience managing in a consumption, usage-based, or product-led business where adoption signals matter as much as renewal or expansion outcomes.

 - Track record building high-performing frontline teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, coaching, and performance management.

 - Experience leading teams through GTM motion changes, coverage-model shifts, or evolving commercial ownership.

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping teams return customers to a clear value path.

 - Experience partnering closely with Solutions Consulting, Sales, Services, or Implementation teams in a shared customer lifecycle model.

 - Familiarity with AI transformation, workflow automation, agents, or collaboration/work management software.

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €123,000-€138,000 per year.

 

By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21

A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

jobs.title: Køkkenmedarbejder til daginstitution på Amager
jobs.description:
Køkkenmedarbejder til daginstitution på Amager

Den integreret institution Sundby Asyl søger en engageret og faglig velfunderet køkkenmedarbejder 27½-30 timer ugentligt. Sundby Asyl huser ca. 44 børn i alderen 0-6 år. Vi er en stabil personalegruppe der mangler en køkkenmedarbejder til at lave mad til børn og personale, og til i øvrigt at drive køkkenet.

Vi holder til i et charmerende hus, tæt på Amagerbro metrostation. Børnene er fordelt på en vuggestuegruppe, en småbørnsgruppe og en børnehavegruppe. Vores hyggelige hus er fordelt på tre niveauer, hvor køkkenet er placeret centralt på husets mellemniveau.

Københavns Kommune har udarbejdet en ambitiøs mad- og måltidsstrategi for kommunens børn, som vi følger.  Dette indeholder krav om økologisk guldmærke, arbejde med klimamål, reducering af madspild, samt tilberedning af klimavenlige og sunde måltider, med udgangspunkt i sæsonens råvare.  

Der serveres morgenmad, formiddagsmad, frokost og eftermiddagsmad til alle børn og voksne i huset. Det er ikke et krav, men bestemt en fordel, hvis du før har lavet mad til børn.

Du har sandsynligvis en køkkenfaglig-og/eller ernæringsuddannelse, og/eller arbejder du ud fra principper om at være eksperimenterende, nysgerrig og modig på smag, farver og sanser.

Fordi du skal arbejde selvstændigt, er det vigtigt, at du er engageret og har interesse for madlavningen, og selv kan sammensætte og planlægge ernæringsrigtige menuer af høj kulinarisk kvalitet, efter fødevarestyrelsens anbefalinger, til børn i alderen 0-6 år.

Du skal udarbejde og publicere madplaner på Aula, samt sørge for varebestilling og modtagelse af vare.

Du er kreativ i et køkken, og laver gerne tingene fra bunden, tager tingene med et smil, og har overskud til børnene og dine kollegaer, også når der er travlt. Ligeledes skal du selvstændig sikre hygiejnestandarden opfylder myndighedernes krav og dagligt udføre egenkontrol. Det er køkkenmedarbejderen der gør rent og rydder op i køkkenet. Du får med andre ord, ansvar for hele køkkenet, og stor mulighed for at præge hverdagen.

I særligt aftalte opgaver omkring traditioner, som jul, påske, fastelavn mm. forventes det at kunne hjælpe udover den faste arbejdstid ved behov.

Mad er pædagogik

Vi ønsker at børnene skal have en bevidsthed om hvad de kommer i munden, og hvor det kommer fra. Maden skal være med til at sikre at børnenes mad mod bliver udfordret og styrket. Stuer og køkken samarbejder i huset om at inddrage børnene i forskellige processer omkring måltiderne. I Sundby Asyl har vi en madpædagog som understøtter dette arbejde.

Yderligere information

Jobbet er en fast stilling på 27½-30 timer om ugen og arbejdstiden ligger mellem kl. 8-13.30/14 på alle hverdage. Jobbet er ledigt pr. 1.2.27. Løn efter gældende overenskomst.

Ønsker du at besøge vores dejlige hus eller vide mere om stillingen er du velkommen til at kontakte vores leder Pia på tlf. 25432276. Yderligere oplysninger om Sundby Asyl kan du få på vores hjemmeside www.sundbyasyl.dk

Ansøgningen sendes senest d. 9/11-26 til mail ansoegning@sundbyasyl.dk I ansøgningen bedes du vedhæfte cv, samt et menuforslag til en uge.

I forbindelse med ansættelsen indhenter vi børne og straffeattest, samt tager referencer.

jobs.title: FRISKSNIT søger medarbejdende teamleder til fødevareproduktion i Hedehusene/FRISKSNIT is hiring a Hands-on Team Leader for Food Production in Hedehusene, Denmark / Permanent, hourly-paid position with 37 paid working hours.
jobs.description:
DANSK:

Timelønnet fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen – med faste arbejdstider søndag–torsdag og fri fredag–lørdag.

Har du øje for kvalitet, kan du holde overblik, og har du lyst til at tage ansvar for et mindre team? Så søger vi dig til vores fødevareproduktion i Hedehusene.

Hos FRISKSNIT søger vi en medarbejdende teamleder, som både deltager i det praktiske produktionsarbejde og koordinerer opgaverne for tre kolleger. Du skal sammen med teamet sikre, at produkterne bliver pakket korrekt, mærket rigtigt og færdige til tiden.

Vi er en fødevareproduktionsvirksomhed med cirka 75 fuldtidsansatte. Vi er medlem af Dansk Industri og omfattet af Industriens Overenskomst.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du bliver ansvarlig for den daglige koordinering i dit team og samarbejder tæt med den produktionsansvarlige. Du deltager selv i produktionen og følger op på, at teamet arbejder effektivt og overholder instruktionerne for kvalitet, hygiejne og sikkerhed.

Dine vigtigste opgaver er at:

  • Koordinere og fordele arbejdet mellem teamets tre øvrige medarbejdere og følge op på dagens opgaver og effektivitet.

  • Sikre korrekt pakning og mærkning, herunder kontrollere emballage, etiketter og datomærkning.

  • Deltage i produktions- og pakkearbejdet samt støtte og oplære kolleger i de aftalte arbejdsgange.

  • Reagere på fejl og forsinkelser og inddrage den produktionsansvarlige, når der er behov for hjælp eller ændrede prioriteringer.

Hvem er du?

Du arbejder omhyggeligt, tager ansvar og bevarer overblikket, når der er travlt. Du kan give tydelige instruktioner og bidrager til et godt samarbejde gennem en respektfuld og hjælpsom tilgang til dine kolleger.

Erfaring fra fødevareproduktion, pakkeri eller lignende er en fordel, men du behøver ikke have en bestemt faguddannelse. Erfaring med koordinering af opgaver eller oplæring af kolleger er også en fordel. Det er ikke et krav, at du tidligere har haft titlen teamleder.

Arbejdssproget er engelsk. Du skal derfor kunne forstå arbejdsinstruktioner og kommunikere tydeligt med kolleger og ledelse på engelsk.

Arbejdstid:

Stillingen er på 37 betalte arbejdstimer om ugen med følgende faste mødetider:

Søndag: kl. 08.00–16.00Mandag–torsdag: kl. 12.00–20.00Fredag og lørdag: fri

Mødetiderne omfatter samlet tre timers ubetalte pauser om ugen. Pauserne indgår ikke i de 37 betalte arbejdstimer. Den konkrete placering af pauserne fremgår af arbejdsplanen.

Arbejdstidens placering følger virksomhedens lokalaftale.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:

Du bliver timelønnet med grundtimeløn, et fast teamledertillæg og relevante tillæg, herunder tillæg for søndagsarbejde.

Ansættelsen sker efter Industriens Overenskomst og virksomhedens gældende lokalaftaler, med pension, feriepenge og fritvalg.

Fritvalg og søgnehelligdagsbidrag udbetales månedligt sammen med lønnen efter virksomhedens aftale.

Du får oplæring i arbejdsopgaverne, vores produkter og de kvalitetskrav, der gælder i produktionen. Du får en praktisk rolle med ansvar for den daglige koordinering og tæt samarbejde med både dit team og den produktionsansvarlige.

Ansættelsesform: Tidsubegrænset fuldtidsansættelse.Arbejdssted: FRISKSNIT, Hedelykken 14, 2640 Hedehusene.Tiltrædelse: Efter aftale.

Sådan søger du

Send dit CV og en kort ansøgning til Job@frisksnit.dk senest fredag den 13. november 2026. Skriv ”Teamleder – FRISKSNIT” i emnefeltet.

Fortæl gerne om din erfaring med produktion, pakning eller koordinering af kolleger, og hvorfor du er interesseret i stillingen. Du er velkommen til at skrive din ansøgning på engelsk.

Spørgsmål til stillingen kan også sendes til Job@frisksnit.dk.

Vi opfordrer alle kvalificerede ansøgere til at søge stillingen.

ENGLISH

Permanent, hourly-paid position with 37 paid working hours per week – fixed working hours Sunday to Thursday, with Fridays and Saturdays off.

Do you have an eye for quality, enjoy organising daily tasks and want to take responsibility for a small team? Join our food production team in Hedehusene.

At FRISKSNIT, we are looking for a hands-on Team Leader who will take part in production while coordinating the work of three colleagues. Together with your team, you will ensure that products are packed correctly, labelled accurately and ready on time.

We are a food production company with approximately 75 full-time employees. We are a member of the Confederation of Danish Industry (DI) and covered by the Danish Industrial Agreement (Industriens Overenskomst).

Your responsibilities

You will coordinate your team’s daily work and work closely with the person responsible for production. You will also take part in production yourself, helping the team work efficiently and follow our quality, hygiene and safety procedures.

Your main tasks will be to:

  • Coordinate and allocate tasks among the three other team members and follow up on daily work and productivity.

  • Ensure correct packing and labelling, including checking packaging, labels and date markings.

  • Take part in production and packing, while supporting colleagues and training them in the agreed procedures.

  • Respond to errors and delays and involve the person responsible for production when support or changes to priorities are needed.

About you

You work carefully, take responsibility and stay organised when things get busy. You can give clear instructions and contribute to good teamwork by treating your colleagues with respect and offering support.

Experience in food production, packing or a similar role is an advantage, but no specific vocational qualification is required. Experience coordinating tasks or training colleagues is also an advantage. You do not need to have held a Team Leader position before.

The working language is English. You must be able to understand work instructions and communicate clearly with colleagues and management in English.

Working hours

The position offers 37 paid working hours per week, with the following fixed schedule:

Sunday: 08:00–16:00Monday–Thursday: 12:00–20:00Friday and Saturday: Days off

jobs.title: 1.assistent til SMP - Fyn
jobs.description:
Vi søger en erfaren 1.assistent til Fyn

Er du serviceminded og kan lide et job med meget kørsel?

SMP Rengøringsservice er i rivende udvikling og søger derfor en erfaren medarbejder på fuldtid (37t), til vores i forvejen stærke team på Fyn.

Som 1.assistent er dit ansvar at sikre afviklingen af den daglige rengøring i samarbejde med din Serviceinspektør

Andre opgaver kan også forekomme.

Du vil have direkte reference til din Serviceinspektør hos SMP rengøringsservice. Jobbet indebærer b.la. følgende arbejdsområder:

•   Skal stå for rengøring af egne pladser og øvrig bemanding iht. rengøringskalenderen

•   Skabe god relation til kunderne

•   Være behjælpelig med afløsning ved. ferie/sygdom

•   Hjælpe ved opstart af nye kunder og opgaver sammen med Serviceinspektør

•   Forefaldne opgaver i samarbejde med din Serviceinspektør

 

Det skal forventes, at timer kan ligge både tidlig morgen, eftermiddag og aften.

 

Hvem er du?

 

Vi søger dig, som trives i en omskiftelig hverdag, hvor opgaverne og dagene aldrig er ens.

Det er ikke vigtigt for dig, at du har faste rammer mandag-fredag fra 8-16, men tværtimod trives du med en flydende hverdag, hvor arbejdsugen kan variere med forskellige tidspunkter på dagen.

Som person kan du nikke genkendende til, at du:

•   Har erfaring med erhvervsrengøring

•   Trives i en til tider hektisk hverdag

•   Står til rådighed for rengøring af egne pladser

•   deler telefonvagt efter forudgående aftale

     står for sidemandsoplæring af rengøringspersonale

•   Kan håndtere og omgås forskellige kulturer

•   Behersker dansk og engelsk i skrift og tale på et rimeligt niveau

•   Har kørekort

•   Kan fremvise straffeattest

Du får stillet en firmabil til rådighed, samt firmatelefon- iPad, og arbejdsbeklædning.

Vi glæder os meget til at lære dig at kende - så hvis du kan se dig selv i denne stilling, bedes du sende din ansøgning til: job@smpservice.dk  - husk at mærke ansøgningen ” 1.assistent Fyn”

 

Samtaler bliver holdt løbende.

 

Har du ikke hørt fra os inden den 04.11.2026, skal du betragte jobbet som besat til anden side.

 

SMP er en velrenommeret virksomhed i rengøringsbranchen, - og det vil vi gerne blive ved med at være

Vi beskæftiger i dag mere end 300 medarbejdere med kunder i en stor del af Danmark. Vi har landsdækkende og lokale aftaler inden for kontor, produktion, skoler, slagterier, bagerier, butikker, supermarkeder mv.

 

SMP har lokale afdelinger både på Fyn, Jylland og Sjælland

jobs.title: VIA søger en proaktiv og erfaren ledelsespartner til Forskningsområde for sundhed og samfund
jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at understøtte et forskningsområde i rivende udvikling? Kan du skabe overblik, struktur og sammenhæng? Og har du mod på at arbejde med en bred pallette af drifts- og ledelsesunderstøttende opgaver?

Så er du måske den ledelsespartner, vi søger i Forskningsområde for sundhed og samfund – til at indgå i vores ledelsespartnerteam, der i fællesskab understøtter forskningschefen, ﬁre centerledere og områdets administrative drift.

Bliv en del af en attraktiv arbejdspladsVi søger en udadvendt, serviceminded og løsningsorienteret medarbejder, der ﬁnder værdi i at medvirke til at få store såvel som små opgaver til at glide i hverdagen i et forskningsområde i vækst. Bliver du en del af VIA, bliver du samtidig en del af en spændende uddannelses- og forskningsinstitution, der hele tiden er i bevægelse og har store ambitioner for vores forskning. Vi tilbyder gode kollegaer, en uformel omgangstone og velfungerende arbejdsforhold med stor grad af ﬂeksibilitet og ansvar.

Ledelsespartnerens opgaveSom ledelsespartner vil du få en bred vifte af opgaver på tværs af Forskningsområde for sundhed og samfund, fx:

  • Være en proaktiv medspiller og fortrolig sparringspartner for forskningschef og centerledere – med struktureret opfølgning, sparring og administrativ støtte til planlægning af processer, aktiviteter og møder.
  • Bidrage til planlægning og administrativ gennemførsel af organisations- og udviklingsprocesser.
  • Varetage den administrative drift af centrene i tæt samarbejde med centerlederne.
  • Løse daglige administrative og praktiske ad hoc-opgaver for forskningschef, centerledere og centrenes medarbejdere.
  • Understøtte intern og ekstern kommunikation i tæt samarbejde med forskningschef og centerledere.
  • Planlægge og koordinere workshops, seminarer, møder og videnformidlingsarrangementer.
  • Udarbejde sagsfremstillinger, notater og præsentationer.
  • Understøtte forskningsområdets strategiske udvikling, herunder bidrage til implementering og opfølgning på strategiske indsatser.
  • Sikre systematisk opfølgning på handlingsplaner, beslutninger og deadlines.
  • Bidrage til budget- og økonomiopfølgning, herunder varetage indkøb, fakturabehandling, udbetalinger mv.

Dine kompetencerDin uddannelsesmæssige baggrund kan være mangeartet, men forventeligt har du en kandidatuddannelse og erfaring med administrativ ledelsesunderstøttelse på en uddannelses- og forskningsinstitution.

Derudover er du serviceminded og har lyst til at arbejde i en stor organisation med mange forskellige kollegaer, interne samarbejdspartnere, hvor du varetager en bred vifte af forskellige opgaver i tæt samarbejde med forskningsområdets anden ledelsespartner.

Som person er du selvstændig i dit arbejde, og du trives med at være proaktiv og påtage dig et ansvar for løsning af opgaverne. Da opgaverne er mangeartede, vil det være en forudsætning, at du løbende er åben for at lære og udviklenye kompetencer. Endelig er det afgørende, at du har sans for planlægning, struktur og processer. Du arbejder uproblematisk med og på tværs af forskellige it-systemer og kan trives i et job, hvor der til tider er mange bolde og agendaer i luften.

Om Forskningsområde for sundhed og samfundForskningsområde for sundhed og samfund udvikler, producerer og formidler ny viden, der kan bidrage til nye sundheds- og samfundsfaglige løsninger til samfundet. Se mere om vores forskningsområde her: www.via.dk/forskning

Vi udfører anvendt og praksisnær forskning i samarbejde med såvel VIAs øvrige forskningsmiljøer, offentlige og private partnere nationalt og internationalt. Vores viden og formidling skal styrke VIAs uddannelser, så den nyeste forskning og videnproduktion medvirker til at uddannelserne i VIA kan matche og skabe værdi i praksis.

jobs.title: Udviklingscenter for Børn og Familier søger familieplejekonsulent.
jobs.description:
Udviklingscenter for Børn og Familier søger familieplejekonsulent.

Vil du være med til at skabe de bedst mulige rammer for børn og unge, der er anbragt i plejefamilie? Og trives du i et arbejde, hvor faglighed, relationer, koordinering og tæt tværfagligt samarbejde går hånd i hånd, så er det måske dig, vi søger som vores nye familieplejekonsulent.

Familieplejen er en del af Udviklingscenter for Børn og Familier (UBF) og består af fire familieplejekonsulenter. Vores fælles mål er at finde de bedst mulige løsninger for det enkelte barn eller unge, når der er behov for anbringelse i plejefamilie.

I Familieplejen i Næstved Kommune arbejder vi ud fra en vision om, at alle anbragte børn og unge skal sikres et godt børneliv og have bedre muligheder i deres voksenliv. Vi har samtidig et stærkt fokus på, at børn og unge får mulighed for at udfolde og udvikle deres evner og kompetencer – både individuelt og i fællesskab med andre.

Vi arbejder ud fra, at børn og unge, der har behov for en familieanbringelse, fortrinsvis skal anbringes i netværkspleje eller plejefamilie frem for på institution, når det er den rette løsning for barnet.

Et tæt samarbejde med myndighed er en central del af jobbet

Som familieplejekonsulent bliver du en vigtig del af det samlede arbejde omkring barnet eller den unge. Du vil derfor have et tæt og forpligtende samarbejde med Børn- og unge rådgivere i Næstved Kommune.

Familieplejekonsulenter og sagsbehandleren har forskellige roller og ansvarsområder, men skal kunne arbejde tæt sammen om at skabe sammenhæng i indsatsen. Det kræver, at du kan indgå i en åben, konstruktiv og professionel dialog – også når sagerne er komplekse, eller perspektiverne er forskellige.

Du skal kunne koordinere, følge op, dele relevante faglige observationer og bidrage aktivt til fælles løsninger, samtidig med at du kan fastholde dit eget faglige ansvar og perspektiv.

Det er derfor vigtigt for os, at du har gode samarbejdsevner, er tydelig i din kommunikation og kan skabe tillidsfulde relationer til både myndighedssagsbehandlere, plejefamilier, børn og unge samt øvrige samarbejdspartnere.

Støtte, råd og vejledning til plejefamilierne

En central del af opgaven som familieplejekonsulent er at understøtte plejefamilierne i deres vigtige og til tider krævende opgave med at skabe trygge og udviklende rammer for de anbragte børn og unge. Du skal kunne tilbyde løbende støtte, faglig rådgivning og vejledning med udgangspunkt i det enkelte barns behov og plejefamiliens aktuelle udfordringer. Det indebærer blandt andet at hjælpe plejefamilierne med at forstå og håndtere barnets reaktioner, adfærd og følelsesmæssige behov samt understøtte deres kompetencer i at skabe stabilitet, trivsel og udvikling i hverdagen. Du skal kunne skabe et tillidsfuldt samarbejde med plejefamilierne, facilitere faglig refleksion og bidrage med konkrete pædagogiske perspektiver og handlemuligheder. Derudover skal du kunne identificere behov for yderligere støtte og indgå i en tæt dialog med relevante samarbejdspartnere for at sikre en helhedsorienteret indsats omkring barnet eller den unge. Rollen indebærer derfor også at være bindeled mellem myndighed og plejefamilien.

Vi forventer, at du

  • Er uddannet pædagog, socialrådgiver eller har anden relevant socialfaglig uddannelse – gerne med relevant efteruddannelse, 
  • Arbejder helhedsorienteret og har blik for at inddrage relevante ressourcer omkring barnet, den unge og plejefamilien.
  • Har erfaring med tæt tværfagligt samarbejde og trives med at samarbejde med rådgivere og andre fagprofessionelle.
  • Kan skabe og vedligeholde professionelle relationer – også i komplekse og krævende situationer.
  • Er tydelig og anerkendende i din kommunikation og kan håndtere forskellige faglige perspektiver på en konstruktiv måde.
  • Kan formidle komplekse problemstillinger både mundtligt og skriftligt og udarbejde præcis og fagligt velfunderet dokumentation.
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt, struktureret og ansvarsfuldt og samtidig være en aktiv del af et kollegialt fællesskab.
  • Har et skarpt blik for børn og unges trivsel og udvikling.
  • Har kørekort og kan stille egen bil til rådighed.

Plejefamilierne modtager supervision i grupper. Det forventes, at du har erfaring med supervision og kan supervisere minde gruppe. Hvis du ikke allerede har denne erfaring, skal du gennemføre relevant kursus eller supervisoruddannelse som en del af din ansættelse.

Vi tilbyder

  • Et fagligt stærkt team med fire familieplejekonsulenter
  • En arbejdsplads, hvor et godt arbejdsmiljø prioriteres højt.
  • Mulighed for faglig udvikling, supervision og løbende faglig sparring
  • Stor fleksibilitet og indflydelse på din arbejdstilrettelæggelse.
  • En arbejdsplads med høj aktivitet, hvor dagene aldrig er ens.
  • Et kollegialt fællesskab, hvor faglige refleksioner og videndeling er en naturlig del af hverdagen.
  • Samarbejde med vore mange plejefamilier.
  • Mulighed for at deltage i temadage og kompetenceudvikling for plejefamilier i samarbejde med andre kommuner.

Løn og ansættelsesforholdLøn- og ansættelsesvilkår sker i henhold til gældende overenskomst mellem den forhandlingsberettigede organisation.

jobs.title: Vil du arbejde med salg, hvor det handler mere om at hjælpe end at sælge?
jobs.description:
Vi søger en elevrådgiver til Vinduespudserskolen – deltid eller fuldtid

Kunne du tænke dig at arbejde med mennesker og hjælpe dem med at finde ud af, om de skal tage springet og starte deres egen forretning?

På Vinduespudserskolen hjælper vi personer med at skifte deres nuværende job ud med deres egen vinduespudserforretning. Eleverne lærer håndværket fysisk på skolen i København og modtager grundig undervisning i forretningsudvikling. Tilsammen giver det dem fundamentet til at bygge en succesfuld vinduespudserforretning.

Vi søger nu en ny kollega, der skal tale med de mange personer, som henvender sig til os med interesse for skolen, og hjælpe dem med at finde ud af, om det er det rigtige valg for dem.

Dine primære opgaver bliver at:

  • Tale med potentielle elever, der allerede har vist interesse for Vinduespudserskolen.

  • Sætte dig ind i deres nuværende situation, baggrund, ambitioner og hvad de gerne vil opnå.

  • Rådgive dem om vores undervisningsforløb, og hvad det kræver at starte sin egen vinduespudserforretning.

  • Hjælpe dem med at vurdere, om skolen og livet som selvstændig er det rigtige match for dem.

  • Følge op på interesserede elever via telefon, SMS og e-mail.

  • Hjælpe de rette personer videre med tilmeldingen til skolen.

Du kommer til at tale med mennesker med vidt forskellige baggrunde og livssituationer. Nogle har været lønmodtagere hele livet, andre driver allerede virksomhed, og nogle står måske midt i et større skifte i deres liv.

For mange er det en stor beslutning, både personligt og økonomisk. Derfor handler jobbet ikke om at overtale nogen til at starte, men om at forstå deres situation og rådgive dem ordentligt.

Vi optager heller ikke nødvendigvis alle, der ønsker at starte. Vores elever bliver en del af et fællesskab, hvor vi kommer til at bruge mange timer sammen, både under undervisningen og efterfølgende. Derfor er det vigtigt for os, at vi lærer folk ordentligt at kende, inden de starter.

Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med Asger og Malte, som også står for din oplæring. Vi forventer ikke, at du kender noget til vinduespudsning på forhånd, men du skal have lyst til at sætte dig grundigt ind i vores forløb, så du med tiden kan rådgive potentielle elever på egen hånd.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har erfaring med rådgivning, salg eller anden form for kundekontakt, eller blot har lyst til at lære det.

  • Kan lide at tale i telefon og gerne tager mange samtaler i løbet af en dag.

  • Er god til at forstå forskellige mennesker og deres situation.

  • Er god til at lytte, stille spørgsmål og give ærlig rådgivning, også når skolen ikke er det rigtige valg for personen.

  • Kan arbejde fysisk fra vores kontor i København.

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine egne opgaver.

  • Trives i en virksomhed, der arbejder som en startup med mange selvstændige og engagerede mennesker.

  • Føler dig hjemme i jargonen på en skole med over 500 elever, som nok bedst kan beskrives som ”en masse meget friske fyre”.

Du behøver ikke have mange års erfaring med salg eller rådgivning. Det vigtigste er, at du er god til mennesker, nysgerrig og har lyst til at lære.

Arbejdstid og praktisk information

Vi er åbne for både deltids- og fuldtidsansættelse, men forestiller os især, at stillingen kunne passe godt til en studerende, der gerne vil have et fleksibelt job ved siden af studiet.

Arbejdstiden ligger mellem kl. 9 og 18 på hverdage, og vi er meget fleksible med planlægningen. Det betyder eksempelvis, at du sagtens kan arbejde 10 timer den ene uge og 30 timer den næste, alt efter hvordan det passer med dit studie eller andre forpligtelser.

Arbejdet foregår fysisk på vores kontor på Vestergade i København, hvor du bliver en del af teamet og får en grundig oplæring.

Løn efter kvalifikationer med mulighed for bonusordning.

Er du ikke selv den rette, men kender du en, så anbefal endelig vedkommende. Vi ansætter, så snart vi finder den rigtige, med opstart hurtigst muligt.

Læs mere og ansøg på linket her https://www.vinduespudserskolen.dk/job-key-account-manager
