jobs.description: SD-26154-POSTDOCTORAL RESEARCHER IN LAND SURFACE MODELLING OF FOREST ECOSYSTEMSFixed term contract | Belvaux | 12 MonthsAre you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join usThe Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organization (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defense technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/How will you contribute?The researcher will participate in two complementary projects focused on modelling forest ecosystem responses across seasonal to decadal timescales: SORTIE (Seasonal Forecast of Forest Status in Luxembourg), funded by the National Collaboration Program (NCP) of the Copernicus Climate Change Services, and HiDRATE (Integrating High resolution Data from Remote sensing And land surface models for Transpiration and Evaporation mapping), funded by the Luxembourg National Research Fund (FNR). The overarching objective is to quantify the predictive capabilities of land surface models in capturing forest ecosystem responses under stress and to translate their outputs into diagnostic indicators. To address these challenges, both projects will jointly employ the latest version of the Community Terrestrial Systems Model (CTSM), multiple in situ measurements (e.g., sap flow, eddy-covariance fluxes, dendrometers), various Earth Observation (EO) data streams, and climate information across multiple temporal scales. The selected candidate will join the Remote Sensing and Natural Resources Modelling group of the Environmental Sensing and Modelling unit and will collaborate closely with the national project partner MeteoLux and the international project partner CESBIO.The selected candidate will play a central role in both projects and their scientific outputs. The primary mission is to: (1) implement the CTSM model across multiple forest monitoring sites; (2) develop a robust analytical framework to assess model sensitivity to environmental drivers using in situ and EO data; and (3) synthesize model outputs into diagnostic indicators that integrate meteorological conditions, forest fluxes, phenological dynamics, biomass productivity, and forest health status. To accomplish these objectives, the candidate will apply advanced statistical methods and leverage high-performance computing (HPC) resources. The candidate will actively contribute to the dissemination, valorisation and transfer of project results. This will include presenting findings at national and international scientific conferences, publishing in reputable peer-reviewed journals, and communicating outcomes to relevant stakeholders. jobs.title: Telecoms Software Engineer (m/f)
jobs.description: Description des tâches:Telecom Software EngineerWith our groundbreaking satellite 5G constellation, OQ Technology is a global leader in satellite IoT connectivity and next-generation non-terrestrial network (NTN) services. As the first company to seamlessly integrate standardized cellular technology with satellites, OQ Technology is transforming how connected devices communicate beyond the reach of terrestrial networks.Our technology enables secure, scalable connectivity for industries including Oil & Gas, Utilities, Mining, Agriculture, Maritime, Logistics, Transport, and Environmental Monitoring, helping organizations monitor and manage critical assets anywhere in the world. We are now extending this capability to 5G NR-NTN direct-to-device (D2D) services, connecting commercial smartphones and dedicated terminals directly to satellites.As we continue to develop our 5G NR-NTN D2D missions, we are looking for an experienced Telecom Software Engineer to join our Telecom Team at our facility in Luxembourg, reporting to the Team Lead. You will develop, integrate and test the OQ 5G gNodeB protocol stack adapted to run onboard our satellites, working across 3GPP specification study, NTN adaptation of L2 and L3, C/C++ implementation, and porting to space-representative processing platforms. You will validate your work hands-on in our telecom lab against commercial smartphones and D2D terminals, and collaborate closely with a multi-disciplinary team spanning the 5G Core, user equipment, and the satellite payload.Job Location:  LUXEMBOURGStarting Date:  Start ImmediatelyJob Type:  UNLIMITEDTasks:  The tasks below are representative and not exhaustive. The Company may assign the post holder to other tasks where it considers this in its interests.General and Teamwork• Contribute to OQ's 5G NR-NTN D2D projects, delivering assigned tasks to the agreed schedule and quality.• Carry out hands-on experiments in the Telecom Lab to test and validate new implementations and theoretical concepts.• Take part in Telecom Team brainstorming sessions and technical discussions, and share relevant findings with the team.• Report task progress and completion status to the Team Lead at regular intervals.• Support colleagues on other project tasks and on hands-on troubleshooting.• Take on additional work on the 3GPP NTN NB-IoT protocol stack, eNodeB and UE sides, including end-to-end and interoperability testing with third-party and commercial devices.Technical• Review mission and project documentation to understand scope, objectives and technical baseline, including statements of work, proposals, 3GPP discussion notes and progress reports.• Study the NR-NTN direct-to-device problem across the use cases, protocol layers and procedures each mission depends on, including services such as SMS over NAS and emergency broadcast, the L2 and L3 adaptations NTN requires, TDD DL-UL pattern design, initial access and system information acquisition, and the effects of long propagation delay and Doppler shift on the link.• Review the relevant 3GPP specifications to extract requirements, confirm compliance and identify technical constraints.• Build working knowledge of the open-source gNodeB stack: code structure, software architecture, build, installation, configuration and execution.• Port and adapt the stack to onboard processing environments, covering cross-compilation, embedded Linux targets, real-time performance, CPU and memory budgets, and interfaces to the FPGA/SDR physical layer.• Develop new C/C++ code blocks from the preceding studies, and carry out unit, functional and end-to-end testing in the lab on representative hardware.• Gain knowledge of the other system elements: the 5G Core Network (5GC), the UE (commercial smartphones or dedicated D2D terminals), and the satellite platform (onboard processing units, FPGA, SDR and RF front-end).• Maintain continuous documentation of research, analysis, requirements, design, proposed solutions and evaluation results.• Commit work to the project GitLab repositories under version control on a continuous basis.• Raise concerns, open questions, risks and critical issues with the team as soon as they are identified.RequirementsEssential• MSc or equivalent in telecommunications, electronic, embedded systems or computer engineering, or a related discipline.• Minimum five years of professional software development experience in telecoms or embedded systems.• Commercial experience in modern C++ (C++17 or later) on Linux, in a real-time or embedded context, including multithreaded and latency-sensitive code.• CMake-based build systems.• Working knowledge of 5G NR Higher L1 and L2 (MAC, RLC, PDCP, RRC) and of the cell search, system information and random-access procedures.• Ability to read 3GPP specifications and translate them into design and code.• Automated unit and integration testing with GoogleTest/GoogleMock or Catch2, run through CTest within GitLab CI, with JUnit XML test reports and code coverage (gcov, lcov or gcovr) published to merge requests.• GitLab workflows: merge requests, code review, and CI/CD pipelines using containerised (Docker) build and test runners.• Debugging and runtime analysis with GDB and sanitisers (AddressSanitizer, ThreadSanitizer, UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer).• Protocol and log analysis using Wireshark and UE or terminal diagnostic tools.• Professional written and spoken English.Desirable• Experience with open-source RAN stacks (for example srsRAN or OpenAirInterface).• Familiarity with 3GPP Release 17 and later NTN features.• MAC scheduler, carrier aggregation or TDD pattern design experience.• Embedded Linux build systems (Yocto, Buildroot) and cross-compilation for ARM targets.• Static analysis tools (clang-tidy, cppcheck) and performance profiling (perf, Valgrind).• SDR platforms (for example USRP) and FPGA-to-software PHY interfaces.• Understanding of satellite systems and orbital effects on the radio link.• Exposure to ECSS software standards (ECSS-E-ST-40C, ECSS-Q-ST-80C).• NB-IoT or NB-IoT NTN protocol experience.• Integration and verification, field testing or interoperability testing with commercial smartphones or dedicated D2D terminals.• Python for test automation (for example pytest).Additional Information:  As part of the recruitment process, candidates may be required to provide a criminal record certificate issued within the last three (3) months.Benefits• Enjoy a 50% income tax exemption on your salary - an exceptional incentive for top talent relocating to Luxembourg, subject to eligibility conditions.• Flexibility to work remotely one day per week.• Opportunity to work on flagship EU space mission projects.• A dynamic, high-growth environment with career development opportunities.• Regular company events and team activities.Études:  Master (Bac+5)Métier / domaine de formation:  MSc or equivalent in telecommunications, electronic, embedded systems or computer engineering, or a related discipline.

jobs.description: Description des tâches:The European Volleyball Confederation (CEV) is the institution responsible for governing 56 National Federations throughout Europe and is recognised as such by the Fédération Internationale de Volleyball (FIVB).Our ultimate goal is to promote Volleyball and Beach Volleyball and to raise the status of our sport to a higher level.Whether the game is played indoors or on sand, Volleyball connects and brings people together from children playing in their free time up to professional and elite athletes.We cultivate a strong sense of togetherness with all stakeholders, the Member National Federations, their national leagues, clubs, players, coaches, organisers and other partners of European Volleyball, from grassroots level to the top events.We are currently looking to recruit a:CRM ManagerLocation: Luxembourg headquartersType of contract: Full time - PermanentDepartment: Digital & TV DepartmentReporting to: Digital, Content & OTT ManagerSalary: CompetitiveStart date: ASAPThe RoleThe European Volleyball Confederation (CEV) is seeking a highly analytical and strategic CRM Manager to join the Digital & TV Department. You will be the primary architect of our fan data ecosystem. Your core mandate is to significantly grow the CEV fan database, develop sophisticated email marketing automations, and build hyper-segmented audiences. You will utilize gamification tools (such as Engage Engine) and high-value incentives to convert anonymous digital traffic intoknown, monetisable contacts, directly driving OTT subscriptions, ticket purchases, and commercial revenue.Key ResponsibilitiesDatabase Growth & Data Capture Strategy:• Develop and execute a comprehensive, multi-channel strategy to significantly grow the CEV fan database, targeting key European and Global markets with demographic and interest segments.• Take full ownership of our gamification and data-capture platforms (e.g., Engage Engine) and design interactive campaigns.• Optimise website data capture points, landing pages, and lead-generation funnels to maximise conversion rates.Email Marketing & Automation:• Manage the end-to-end creation, scheduling, and deployment of all CEV email communications, including newsletters, promotional offers, and event announcements.• Design, build, and maintain automated email journeys (e.g., welcome series, abandoned cart for OTT, subscription win-back campaigns, birthday offers).• Conduct continuous A/B testing on subject lines, content layouts, and call-to-actions to improve open rates, click-through rates, and overall conversion.Segmentation & Targeting:• Build and maintain a highly structured and segmented database, ensuring data hygiene and compliance with GDPR regulations.• Categorise fan based on granular data points including geography, favoured national teams, preferred clubs, and past purchasing behaviour (e.g., PPV buyers vs. annual subscribers).• Utilise this segmentation to deploy hyper-targeted, localised marketing campaigns that increase fan engagement and reduce subscriber churn.Reporting & Commercial Insights:• Provide comprehensive monthly performance reports detailing database growth metrics, email campaign performance, and subscriber acquisition costs.• Generate custom commercial reports for the leadership team and Commercial Department, proving the monetary value of our segmented audiences.• Translate raw data into actionable insights, advising the Digital & TV team on which fan segments offer the highest potential for commercial monetisation.Qualifications & Your analysis - built on SQL, statistical methods, data visualization, and generative AI — will directly support capital investment decisions (where and when to add fulfillment center capacity, retrofits, and building design) as well as operational decisions around staffing strategy and under-the-roof productivity.This is a particularly exciting time to join: the team is actively integrating Same Day delivery into our First Mile topology strategy, opening up new problems to solve and new impact to drive. You will split your time between analytical work (roughly 75%) and cross-functional project management (roughly 25%), working with senior leaders on high-stakes recommendations that shape how we move goods across Europe.Key job responsibilities- Analyze First Mile network capacity, flow, and cost data using SQL, statistical modeling, and data visualization to build recommendations that inform capital and operational investment trade-offs across the European delivery network.- Collaborate with partner teams to influence and maintain a roadmap of First Mile improvement projects, launching pilots for the most complex opportunities and building scale-up business cases that quantify benefits, risks, and required resources.- Design and maintain analytics tools and dashboards — applying generative AI where it accelerates insight — to surface defects, track process performance, and extract actionable findings from pickup through fulfillment center injection.- Lead regular business reviews with cross-functional stakeholders to monitor project progress, identify and remove bottlenecks, and drive alignment on priorities.- Consolidate findings into concise, data-driven status updates and present recommendations to senior leadership, managing stakeholder expectations and adapting communication to your audience.A day in the lifeImagine we need to decide whether a new fulfillment center in one region versus another best unlocks faster delivery for customers. You would own that question end to end: form a defensible first answer from existing data, pinpoint the injection volumes, line-haul lanes, and sortation readiness data that would confirm or challenge it, then quantify the speed benefit against capital and operating costs. You bring transportation, fulfillment center operations, and last-mile partners along as you work, and package everything into a clear recommendation for senior leadership. The expectation is a sound, numbers-backed decision in days — set up to refresh quickly and scale — not a perfect answer in a month.About the teamOur Long Term Planning team sits within Amazon's European operations organization and is responsible for tackling the most complex supply chain problems and decisions. We are a group of engineers, analysts, and scientists who work across fulfillment centers, transportation, finance, and retail teams to continuously improve how goods move from vendors and sellers to customers throughout Europe.Because the decisions you support carry significant capital weight, you will have regular exposure to senior leadership — an environment that sharpens your communication skills and professional confidence. We are an inclusive, collaborative team that values rigorous analysis and practical problem-solving as we rethink our end-to-end supply chain to make deliveries even faster.Basic Qualifications- Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience in Business, Engineering, Supply Chain, Transportation, Mathematics, Economics, Physics or another technical field- Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Engineering, Supply Chain, Economics or Business Administration- Experience in analytical tasks or projects, working with data- Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Math, Engineering, Science or Business- Experience making strategic business decisions and managing internal relationships, or experience in a finance role leading a project or program and partnering with multiple stakeholders within a business- Experience engaging, verbally and in writing, with internal and external stakeholders to convey complex ideas in a clear, concise mannerPreferred Qualifications- Master's degree in mathematics, engineering, statistics, computer science, business administration or a related field- Experience working in a fast-paced and ambiguous environmentAmazon is an equal opportunities employer. jobs.description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Lagerarbeiter; Kommissionierer; Fachlagerist; Lagerhelfer MöbellogistikStellenbeschreibung:Damit morgens jede Tour startklar istSeit 1934 stehen wir für Qualität, Beratung und Handschlag-Mentalität. Heute führen wir als Familienunternehmen in dritter Generation mit knapp 50 Mitarbeitern zwei starke Marken: Möbel Kerkfeld für hochwertige Einrichtung mit Tradition und Skurios für Trend und Lifestyle.Und wir wachsen: Wir erweitern unsere Ausstellung, gewinnen neue Kunden und bekommen mehr Aufträge. Damit jedes Möbelstück vollständig und unbeschädigt beim Kunden ankommt, braucht es jemanden, der in unserem 2.500 m² großen Zentrallager den Überblick behält. Sie sorgen dafür, dass unsere Monteure und Schreiner morgens alles abholen können, was sie für ihren Tag brauchen.Das sind Sie. jobs.title: Business Analyst Settlement / Depotüberträge (m/w/d) (Business-Analyst/in)
jobs.description: Einzigartiger Service braucht ein großartiges TeamDie Deutsche WertpapierService Bank AG ist mit über 22 Jahren Erfahrung im Wertpapiergeschäft der führende Dienstleister für Wertpapierservices in Deutschland. Mit unserer Systemplattform WP3 verarbeiten wir für über 1.000 Banken jedes Jahr mehrere Millionen Wertpapiertransaktionen – schnell, stabil und sicher. An unseren Standorten in Frankfurt, Düsseldorf und München arbeiten über 1.200 Mitarbeitende tagtäglich daran, dass unsere Kundeninstitute am Finanzplatz Deutschland erfolgreicher sind. Unser Anspruch: Erste Wahl für Wertpapierservices zu sein. Lass uns diese spannende Herausforderung gemeinsam angehen!Das erwartet dich:Unsere Abteilung umfasst 15 Mitarbeitende, die an den Standorten Düsseldorf und Eschborn (bei Frankfurt) tätig sind. Fünf Kolleg:innen des Teams kümmern sich um alle relevanten Themen im Umfeld Clearing/Settlement und Depotüberträge. Das Team fungiert als zentrale Schnittstelle und beratender Partner zwischen den bankfachlichen Abteilungen und der IT-Entwicklung. Im Fokus unserer Arbeit steht die strukturierte Analyse fachlicher Anforderungen sowie deren Übersetzung in effiziente und tragfähige IT-Lösungen.Als Analyst (m/w/d) Business Consulting übersetzt du komplexe fachliche Anforderungen in tragfähige Lösungen und sorgst dafür, dass Depotüberträge und Clearing / Settlement Prozesse für unsere Kund:innen effizient, sicher und zukunftsfähig bleiben.- Business Analyse: Gemeinsam mit deinem Team entwickelst du unser Wertpapierabwicklungssystem rund um Depotüberträge sowie Clearing / Settlement kontinuierlich weiter.- Projektgestaltung: Du leitest und begleitest mittlere bis große Projekte von der ersten Idee über Analyse und Umsetzung bis zum Go-live – mit klassischen oder agilen Methoden.- Schnittstellen- & Anforderungsmanagement: Du verbindest Fachbereich und IT, analysierst Prozesse, strukturierst komplexe Anforderungen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit den Beteiligten nachhaltige Lösungen.- Qualität & Testing: Du konzipierst Testkonzepte, steuerst die Testphasen und sorgst dafür, dass neue Funktionen zuverlässig eingeführt werden.- Analyse & Beratung: Du verantwortest Vorstudien, bewertest Machbarkeit und Aufwand und schaffst damit eine fundierte Entscheidungsgrundlage für deine Stakeholder:innen.- Vernetzung & Teamspirit: Du gestaltest bereichsübergreifend Beziehungen, förderst den Wissenstransfer und stärkst das Wir-Gefühl im Team. Dazu tätigst du auch Dienstreisen zwischen unseren Standorten in Düsseldorf und Eschborn (Frankfurt).Das bieten wir dir:- Flexible Arbeitsmodelle: 39 Stunden/Woche (Vollzeit), flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung und 60 % Remote-Work- **Urlaub: **30 Urlaubstage/Jahr., 24.12. & 31.12. frei, ab 2 Jahren Betriebszugehörigkeit Kauf von weiteren Urlaubstagen möglich- **Workation: **bis zu 25 Tage pro Jahr aus dem EU-Ausland arbeiten- **Weiterbildung: **zahlreiche Entwicklungsangebote (bspw. Talentprogramme, Trainings, Barcamps) und LinkedIn Learning- Mobilität: Fahrradleasing, kostenloses Deutschlandticket und buchbare, kostenlose Parkplätze vor Ort- **Fitness: **EGYM Wellpass (30 € Eigenanteil/Monat) für Sport-, Wellness- und Mental-Health-Angebote- **Zusatzleistungen und Vergünstigungen: **u.a. vermögenswirksame Leistungen, betriebl. Altersvorsorge, Corporate Benefits- **Kulinarik: **bezuschusstes Essensangebot in unseren Kantinen, Barista-Bars und natürlich gratis Wasser, Kaffee...- **Technisches Setup: **u.a. höhenverstellbare Schreibtische und 2 Monitore im Büro. Monitor, Tastatur und Maus für Remote-Work- **Familiensupport: **Keep-in-Touch-Programm während der Elternzeit und 70 €/Monat Kinderbetreuungskostenzuschuss- **Unterstützung im Notfall: **Pflegeberatung sowie anonyme Unterstützung bei beruflichen, familiären und privaten Notsituationen- **Prävention: **kostenlose Vorsorgeuntersuchungen vor OrtDas zeichnet dich aus:- Du hast ein Studium oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung (im MINT-Bereich) abgeschlossen und verfügst über mehrjährige, praktische Erfahrung im Bereich Depotüberträge oder Clearing & Settlement. SWIFT-Formate und gängige Settlement-Plattformen sind dir vertraut.- Du hast bereits Projekte – klassisch oder agil – erfolgreich geleitet und bringst ein gutes Verständnis für Systemarchitekturen und technische Zusammenhänge mit.- Du kannst komplexe Themen verständlich vermitteln, unterschiedliche Perspektiven (IT, Fachbereich und Management) zusammenbringen und gemeinsam tragfähige Lösungen entwickeln.- Du arbeitest strukturiert und proaktiv, übernimmst gerne Verantwortung, denkst vernetzt und hast Freude daran, Neues zu lernen und dein Wissen weiterzugeben.- Kenntnisse in der steuerlichen Verarbeitung von Depotüberträgen, beispielsweise im TAXBOX-Verfahren oder bei Finanzamt-Meldungen, sind ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung.- Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch (min. C1) und sehr gut Englisch (min. B2).Haben wir dein Interesse geweckt?Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.Bei Rückfragen kannst du dich an **Tini Masuch **im Personalmanagement unter karriere[at]dwpbank.de wenden.Bitte beachte, dass Bewerbungen per E-Mail nicht berücksichtigt werden können.Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Behinderung sind ausdrücklich erwünscht.Die dwpbank setzt sich für Vielfalt und ein wertschätzendes, faires Arbeitsumfeld ein, das alle Talente unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder sexueller Orientierung willkommen heißt.Erfahre Aktuelles auf unserem LinkedIn-Profiloder unsererUnternehmensseite.

jobs.description: SAPV-/ Palliative Care Pflegefachkraft (m/w/d) Diakonie-Station Steglitz in BerlinWeil wir #pflegeleben!Im Gemeindehaus der Evangelischen Markusgemeinde hat unsere Diakonie-Station Steglitz ihren Sitz – eine der ältesten Sozialstationen Berlins. Dass das gelingt, dafür sorgt unser Palliative Care Team.„Heilen manchmal, lindern oft, trösten immer.“ Nach diesem Satz arbeiten wir. Unser Team ist erfahren, gut eingespielt und hält zusammen. Wir suchen dich als Verstärkung.Komm ins Team Diakonie!Dein Aufgabengebiet:Du bist bei schwer erkrankten Menschen zu Hause – und bei denen, die sie begleiten. Wir tragen das gemeinsam, auch nachts.Palliative Begleitung kann jeder Mensch brauchen, ganz gleich, wie alt er ist. jobs.title: Forstwirtschaftsmeister (w/m/d) (Forstwirtschaftsmeister/in)
jobs.employer: Forstliche Versuchs- und Forschungsanstalt Baden- Württemberg
jobs.description: Die Forstliche Versuchs- und Forschungsanstalt (FVA) ist die Ressortforschungseinrichtung des Landes für den Wald und dem Ministerium für Ländlichen Raum, Landwirtschaft und Heimat Baden- Württemberg (MLR) zugeordnet.Gesetzlicher Auftrag der FVA ist es, durch anwendungsorientierte Forschung in allen waldbezogenen Belangen zur Sicherung einer nachhaltigen Waldwirtschaft auf wissenschaftlicher und rationaler Basis beizutragen.Mit einem engagierten Team mit über dreihundert Beschäftigten greift die FVA praktische Fragen von Forstbetrieben ebenso auf wie Fragen des Artenschutzes, der Walderhaltung oder des Konfliktmanagements in Erholungswäldern.Bei der Abteilung Waldnaturschutz ist zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt am Standort Freiburg die Stelle alsForstwirtschaftsmeister (w/m/d)für die Anlage, Betreuung und Verwaltung von landesweiten Versuchsflächen und Samenplantagen des Arbeitsbereiches Waldgenetik und Forstliches Vermehrungsgut in Vollzeit 100 % zu besetzen. Die Stelle ist unbefristet.Aufgaben- Organisation und Durchführung von Anlage und Unterhaltung von Versuchsflächen und Samenplantagen (Einmessung, Pflanzung und Koordinierung von Pflege- und Kulturarbeiten, Nachpflanzungen, Erneuerung der Vermarkung) im landesweiten Zuständigkeitsbereich der FVA in enger Abstimmung mit der Abteilungs- bzw. Arbeitsbereichsleitung sowie den zuständigen Forstbehörden- Planung und Durchführung von Datenaufnahmen auf landesweiten Versuchsflächen (z.B. Aufnahme von Baumhöhe und Brusthöhenmesser, Ausfallrate und Vitalität) in Abstimmung mit den Projektleitungen- Verarbeitung und Einpflegen von Flächendaten und -plänen sowie von Aufnahmedaten aus Versuchsflächen in Datenbanken des Arbeitsbereichs- Organisation und Durchführung von Arbeitseinsätzen im Versuchsgelände der FVA im Liliental- Teamleitung bei Außeneinsätzen- Koordination von Unternehmereinsätzen- Durchführung von Motorsägenkursen für Bundesfreiwillige und interne Mitarbeiter- Unterstützung in der Betreuung von technischen Anlagen in Forstbaumschule und Gewächshäusern (Bewässerung, Düngung, Schattierung, Pflanzenschutz)- Vertretung der Leitung der Versuchsbaumschule- Führungen und Exkursionen von Fachgruppen, Führungen für Auszubildende und SchulenAnforderungen- Ausbildung zum Forstwirtschaftsmeister oder vergleichbares Ausbildungsprofil (Gärtnermeister GaLa-Bau, Landwirtschaftsmeister)- Organisationsgeschick und Bereitschaft zur Übernahme von Verantwortung- Sehr gute Teamfähigkeit und Kommunikationsfähigkeit- Einsatzfreude an der Arbeit im Freien, volle körperliche Leistungsfähigkeit und Belastbarkeit, auch in schwierigem Gelände, sowie Bereitschaft zu mehrtägigen Außendiensten innerhalb Baden-Württembergs.- Gültiger Führerschein für die Fahrzeugklasse B und PKW-Anhängern und Bereitschaft zum Führen von Traktoren- Grundkenntnisse in gängiger Bürosoftware (MS-Office)- Bereitschaft zum Einsatz von GIS- und EDV Systemen zur Erhebung und Verarbeitung von VersuchsdatenVon Vorteil sind- Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Leitung von Teams- Erfahrung in der Vermehrung und Kulturführung von Gehölzen- Erfahrungen mit forstlichen Versuchsanlagen- Kenntnisse im Umgang mit forstlichem Vermehrungsgut- Führerschein Klasse BE und TUnser Angebot- Bezahlung je nach Qualifizierung bis zu Entgeltgruppe 8 TV-Forst- Abwechslungsreiche und sinnstiftende Aufgaben in einem motivierten und kollegialen Umfeld- Vereinbarkeit von Familie und Beruf: familienfreundliche Arbeitszeitmodelle und eine waldpädagogisch ausgerichtete Kindertagesstätte- Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice-Möglichkeit- Nachhaltige Mobilität mit dem JobTicket BW und dem JobBike BW- Attraktive Gesundheitsangebote inklusive Firmenfitness- Vielfältige Fort- und WeiterbildungsmöglichkeitenFür uns zählt der Mensch. Daher denken wir nicht in Kategorien, lehnen jegliche Diskriminierung ab und freuen uns über eine große Vielfalt in unserem Team.Die Stelle ist grundsätzlich teilbar.Bewerbungen von schwerbehinderten und ihnen gleichgestellten behinderten Menschen werden ausdrücklich begrüßt und diese bei im Wesentlichen gleicher Eignung bevorzugt eingestellt.BewerbungBitte bewerben Sie sich bis 15.11.2026 online über unser Bewerbungsportal (https://www.fva-bw.de/top-meta-navigation/karriere) .Ihre Unterlagen werden nach Abschluss des Bewerbungsverfahrens unter Beachtung datenschutzrechtlicher Bestimmungen vernichtet bzw. gelöscht. Sie sind ein verlässlicher Ansprechpartner, wenn es darum geht, unsere Teilnehmenden durch ihre Maßnahme zu begleiten? Sie haben eine Vorstellung vom Ausbildungsalltag junger Leute? Sie wirken bei Ihrer abwechslungsreichen Tätigkeit direkt in den Werkstätten mit, stimmen sich im Reha-Team ab und unterstützen unsere Teilnehmenden bei allem, was neben und während des Ausbildungsalltags anfällt.Psychische Belastungen und/oder Autismus oder Lernbehinderung machen diesen Weg für unsere Teilnehmenden herausfordernd. auch Priorisieren der anstehenden Aufgaben- Sicherheit und Routine im Umgang mit dem Dokumentationswesen- Organisation und Begleitung der Teilnehmenden während betrieblicher Phasen- ...Was Sie mitbringen- Sie haben das Studium "Soziale Arbeit" abgeschlossen- Sie arbeiten gerne mit jungen Menschen und in einem multiprofessionellen Team- Sie haben bereits Berufserfahrung, idealerweise im Bereich der beruflichen Reha- Sie besitzen eine Rehabilitationsspezifische Zusatzqualifikation oder freuen sich darauf, diese zu absolvieren- Sie arbeiten mit unseren Teilnehmenden auf Augenhöhe- Sie schätzen vernetzte Arbeit im Team und eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten, sind gut strukturiert und organisiert und behalten Termine und Ziele im Blick- Sie sind belastbar, können auf Herausforderungen flexibel reagieren und sind lösungsorientiert- Sie sind bereit, junge Menschen in alltäglichen Dingen wie auch in Krisensituationen zu unterstützen- Sie besitzen einen Führerschein der Klasse BSchwerbehinderte Bewerberinnen und Bewerber werden bei gleicher Eignung besonders berücksichtigt.Interessiert?Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung über unser Online-Bewerbungsformular!

jobs.description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Associate Principal, Product OperationsStellenbeschreibung:Company DescriptionAs the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.Job DescriptionJob Ref ID: JR0087194We are on the lookout for an Associate Principal, Product Operations (Enterprise Device Management) to join our Restaurant vertical team in Berlin on our journey to always deliver amazing experiences.As part of our Vendor Team, you’ll be the driving force behind the success of thousands of restaurants, shops, and local businesses. Your contributions will empower vendors with advanced tools to manage their operations, boosting their visibility and reach. Every feature you help build will create growth opportunities for businesses of all sizes, strengtheningThe Global Vendor Operations team at Delivery Hero consists of smart and driven people from all around the world who work closely together with our entities worldwide to ensure each and every local or regional operations team performs in their most efficient way. We assist senior management and the local teams to make their operations run smoothly. Furthermore, we are responsible for understanding the quality of our restaurant partners experience of our products and services globally to identify new feature requirements to feed into the product roadmap.In this role you will- Manage and optimize our global restaurant device fleet – from allocation and provisioning to lifecycle management across all our markets.- Operate and enhance our Device Management ecosystem (Android OS and Devices), ensuring smooth daily operations across device configuration, enrollment, policy and compliance management, account setup, incident and ticket troubleshooting, device support, and coordination of country-specific change requests.- Plan, coordinate and execute global software rollouts including app updates, firmware upgrades, staged rollouts, rollback strategies, and post-deployment monitoring.- Test and QA Android devices, firmware versions, and MDM configurations to ensure stability and readiness for global rollouts.- Collaborate with the MDM Product Owner to further develop integrations with internal systems and improve operational workflows.- Build transparency and operational structure by contributing to project documentation, knowledge bases, training materials, efficient ticketing processes, and process optimisation, while participating in on-call duties to support our global user base and technical operations when required.Qualifications- 5+ years of relevant experience managing large-scale Android device environments, including both consumer and B2B devices.- In-depth knowledge of a MDM platform, ideally SOTI MobiControl; Teams.- Abgeschlossenes Studium im technischen, wirtschaftlichen oder vergleichbaren Bereich.- Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse.Ihre Perspektive – jobs.title: Elternbegleiterin (m/w/d) für die Arbeit im Projekt ElternChanceN im Familienzentrum (Erzieher/in)
jobs.description: Der Kinderschutzbund Regionalverband Freiberg e.V. ist ein anerkannter Träger der freien Jugendhilfe mit Sitz in Freiberg. In unseren Einrichtungen sind wir mit verschiedensten Angeboten Partner für Kinder, Jugendliche und deren Erziehungsberechtigte. Dabei ist es für uns grundliegende Aufgabe, dafür zu sorgen, dass die Rechte der Kinder gesellschaftlich wahrgenommen werden. Wir handeln nach den Grundsätzen von Diversität, Weltoffenheit und Vielfalt.  Das Projekt ElternChanceN (https://elternchancen-muenchen.de/projektbeschreibung) in Freiberg wird im Rahmen des ESF Plus-Programms „ElternChanceN – mit Elternbegleitung Familien stärken“ durch das Bundesministerium für Familie, Senioren, Frauen und Jugend und durch die Europäische Union über den Europäischen Sozialfonds Plus (ESF Plus) gefördert. Elternbegleitung unterstützt Familien in besonderen Lebenslagen bei Erziehungsfragen und Bildungsprozessen. Elternbegleitung schafft einen vertrauensvollen Zugang zu Familien, führt niedrigschwellige Begleitungs- und Beratungsangebote durch, bietet Unterstützung bei der Alltagsbewältigung und vermittelt an passende Angebote der Kinder- und Jugendhilfe. Sie hilft Eltern, bestmögliche Bildungsentscheidungen für ihre Kinder zu treffen. Elternbegleitung stärkt eine frühzeitige und individuelle Entwicklungsförderung und trägt damit nachhaltig zu besseren Bildungs- und Teilhabechancen von Kindern bei. Elternbegleitung bezieht die Übergänge von der Familie in die außerhäusliche Betreuung und von der KiTa in die Schule mit ein. Wir suchen Sie ab sofort als Elternbegleiterin (m/w/d) für die Arbeit im Projekt ElternChanceN im Familienzentrum (anerkannte/r Erzieher:in) in Freiberg mit einem Stundenumfang von 19,5h, befristet bis 31.05.2028.   Wir bieten:  - eine gute Zusammenarbeit in einem engagierten Team von Kolleg:innen, die sich fachlich und persönlich einbringen, - ein interessantes, abwechslungsreiches und entwicklungsfähiges Arbeitsfeld, - Möglichkeiten der fachlichen Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Einrichtungen des Trägers und extern, - interne und externe Fortbildungen, - Bezahlung in Anlehnung an den TVÖD,  - Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, - Jahreseinmalzahlung und Leistungszulage Sie bringen mit:  - Sie haben einen Abschluss als anerkannte/r Erzieher:in.  - Sie sind eine offene und engagierte Person, die die Fähigkeit besitzt, eigenständig Angebote für Eltern und Familien mit Kindern bis zum Grundschulalter vor Ort zu gestalten. - jobs.title: Fullstack Engineer II, Dmarts – Quick Commerce (Fullstack-Entwickler/in)
jobs.description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Software Engineer IIStellenbeschreibung:Company DescriptionAs the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.Job DescriptionBig systems. Exciting challenges. Real impact. As a Software Engineer II (Fullstack), you'll take ownership of features across our Supply Chain Engineering systems — from Purchase Orders and Store Transfers to Cross Dock operations and Returns — building the backend services and integrations that keep inventory moving efficiently across our network. You'll design event-driven, Kafka-based workflows that connect our platform to external Warehouse Management Systems, and see your code go straight into production supporting Quick Commerce's growing Non-Food business.Our team builds technology that enables inventory to move efficiently across our supply chain network (from procurement and replenishment to distribution centers, stores and other inventory movements). We own and evolve systems supporting Purchase Orders, Store Transfers, Cross Dock operations and Returns orders, as well as capabilities around Distribution Centers operations, inventory visibility and WMS integrations. Our systems operate across multiple markets and integrate with different internal platforms and external WMS, creating interesting challenges around distributed workflows, data consistency, reliability and system integration.Be part of redefining how customers experience quick commerce. You'll help build technology that scales our non-food offerings, reaching new market segments and driving revenue growth. By innovating within our Quick Commerce Team, you'll make Delivery Hero the go-to platform for a broad range of products, helping us grow faster and deliver more value to customers around the world.- Develop backend services using Golang/Python and frontend applications using React- Design and evolve APIs, event-driven workflows, and Kafka-based integrations — including with internal platforms and external Warehouse Management Systems and logistics platforms- Partner with Product Managers, engineers, and operational stakeholders to translate business problems into scalable technical solutions- Make technical decisions within your features and contribute to broader architecture and design discussions within the team- Own the complete software lifecycle: design, implementation, automated testing, deployment, observability, and production operation- Investigate production issues and improve system reliability, performance, resilience, and observabilityQualifications- Professional experience building and operating production software, with the ability to independently own features from problem understanding through production delivery- Strong experience with at least one backend programming language — Golang or Python is particularly relevant, with the willingness to work across our backend stack- Experience building modern web applications using React or comparable technologies, integrating them with backend APIs- Solid understanding of software design principles, REST APIs, relational databases, and automated testing, with the ability to reason about technical trade-offs- Experience or good understanding of distributed/event-driven systems and production infrastructure such as Kafka, AWS, Docker/k8s, CI/CD, and observability- A collaborative and proactive jobs.title: Pädagog:innen mit herausragenden Englischkenntnissen (Erzieher/in)

jobs.description: Create your own happiness!Are you a passionate early childhood educator (m/f/d)? Do you put your heart and soul into your work, but haven’t been satisfied with your working conditions so far?Come check us out—maybe you’ll like what you find here?What you can look forward to…The basics: pay, vacation time, and working hours.We are actually offering a fixed-term full-time position. The full-time workweek is 38 hours. Initially, the contract would be fixed-term, but an extension is possible.Pay is based on the TVöD SuE collective bargaining agreement and depends on your professional experience and qualifications. A 13th month’s salary (at 100%, instead of 85%) is paid after one year of service. We have between 32 and 34 days of vacation per year. Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve are paid holidays. The cost of an HVV/Deutschlandticket is fully covered, and if interested, you can participate in a fitness program.The Position: Responsibilities and Working Conditions.We are looking for at least one new early childhood educator with a perfect command of the English language.Your responsibilities include the attentive care, nurturing, and support of the children (age 1-6) entrusted to us in line with our educational approach, working closely with the children, parents, and the entire team. In your daily work, you would speak mainly English.We would appreciate at least some experience in this field and a preference for this age group would be advantageous.Our working conditions are truly worth highlighting: In the elementary section, four colleagues together care for 35 children; in the nursery section, four additional colleagues care for 16 children. In addition, we employ a housekeeping staff member with educational qualifications and, in the future, a substitute.We hold weekly team meetings to discuss weekly schedules, activities, and specific situations, as well as to plan parent-teacher conferences and developmental meetings. Our sponsoring organization places great emphasis on providing good working conditions.The Team: One for all, all for one!Some of us have been working together successfully and happily for over ten years. It goes without saying that we support one another and treat each other with care. Our sense of humor and our willingness to stand up for one another carry us through the sometimes hectic daily routine of the daycare center.On concept days, we discuss educational topics, engage in professional development, and reflect on our work. Regular weekly team meetings, preparation time, and supervision are just as much a part of our routine as extended get-togethers during company outings and Christmas parties.Has this piqued your curiosity? Then you should definitely keep reading…Important: Empathy, joy, and qualifications.To ensure we comply with legal requirements, it is very important that our new team member holds a completed, state-recognized qualification as an early childhood educator (m/f/d), a degree in early childhood education or early childhood development, or a degree as a social pedagogue (m/f/d). It would be helpful if you have a good understanding of the English language, as we are a bilingual facility.We are looking for an empathetic person with a Reggio Emilia approach (including a child-centered perspective) and someone who genuinely enjoys working with children, because we want you to look forward to coming to work.Feel free to get to know us!The Daycare Center: Location. Concept. Focus Areas.The daycare center is located in the heart of Planten un Blomen and is surrounded by plenty of greenery. It is easily accessible by public transportation from all parts of Hamburg (Gänsemarkt, Dammtor, Stephansplatz).There are two groups, a nursery group and an elementary group, in which 42-48 children are currently cared for by nine early childhood educators. Our facilities allow us to organize various projects and activities in workshops and specialized rooms.The foundation of our concept is the Reggio approach. Above all, it reflects our attitude toward others and how we wish to approach life’s changes. Our daycare is a place for self-directed, holistic learning, and we foster a respectful approach not only toward the children entrusted to us, but toward all people.We integrate key areas such as yoga, woodworking, art studio work, language development, music, relaxation and movement, and preschool preparation into our daily routine. Do you have a particular focus? A passion? Let’s find out together if we can integrate this into our daily routine as well…Start up initiative: Kindertagesstätte an der Bucerius Law School e.V.Our small operator, “Kindertagesstätte an der Bucerius Law School e.V.”, was founded in 2008 and is a member of the Paritätischer Wohlfahrtsverband Hamburg. Loki Schmidt was the founding patron of our daycare center.Our organization consists of a single facility. This means that decisions can be made and implemented quickly, easily, and on an individual basis. Here, people are still allowed to be people; they are heard and are not just a personnel number.As a member of the Bucerius family and an initiative of the ZEIT STIFTUNG BUCERIUS, our work makes an important contribution to promoting an open, democratic society.The Future: Do you think we’re a good fit for you?Then please send us your application materials. We would love to get to know you.If you’re interested, feel free to check out our website (https://www.law-school.de/services/kita (https://www.law-school.de/services/kita) ) or our Instagram account (kita.buceriuslaw).Thank you for your attention, and we hope to see you soon!

Dokazi potrebni za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju objavljeni su na internet stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja RH: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf Radni odnos se zasniva na neodređeno vrijeme, uz obvezni probni rad u trajanju od šest mjeseci. Na javni natječaj mogu se javiti osobe oba spola. Riječi i pojmovi u ovom natječaju koji imaju rodno značenje odnose se jednako na muški i ženski rod bez obzira na to jesu li korišteni u muškom ili ženskom rodu. Javni natječaj je objavljen na mrežnim stranicama Društva www.vik-ka.hr i Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje. Osoba koja nije podnijela pravodobnu i urednu prijavu na natječaj neće se smatrati kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj. O rezultatima izbora kandidati će biti pisano obaviješteni u roku od 30 dana od završetka natječaja. Urednom prijavom smatra se prijava koja sadrži svu potrebnu dokumentaciju navedenu u natječaju i koja je pristigla na adresu tvrtke zaključno s datumom 31.10.2026. godine. Prijave na natječaj s prilozima dostavljaju se na adresu Vodovod i kanalizacija d.o.o., Gažanski trg 8, 47 000 Karlovac sa naznakom »Natječaj za komunalnog radnika u odvodnji – ne otvaraj». Vodovod i kanalizacija d.o.o. Karlovac zadržava pravo poništiti javni natječaj u bilo kojem trenutku ne navodeći razloge poništenja.

Obavlja poslove na čišćenju i održavanju objekata i postrojenja u sklopu sustava odvodnje, vrši čišćenje slivnika, radi na ispumpavanju septičkih jama, te na odčepljenju javne i kućne kanalizacije.

Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata („Narodne novine“ broj 84/21) uz prijavu na natječaj dužan/a je, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti dokaze potrebne za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju navedene na mrežnoj stranici Ministarstva Hrvatskih branitelja Republike Hrvatske: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata („Narodne novine“ broj 33/92,77/92,86/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 94/01, 103/03, 148/13) uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i rješenja odnosno potvrdu iz koje je vidljivo spomenuto pravo te dokaz iz kojeg je vidljivo na koji je način prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca. Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom („Narodne novine“ broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18) uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom, odnosno javnu ispravu o invaliditetu na temelju koje se osoba može upisati u očevidnik zaposlenih osoba s invaliditetom te dokaz iz kojeg je vidljivo na koji je način prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca. Kandidati koji ostvaruju prednost pri zapošljavanju temeljem nekog drugog posebnog Zakona, dužni su u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti preslike rješenja ili potvrde o priznatom pravu te svu ostalu dokumentaciju temeljem koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti. Prije zapošljavanja, potrebno je priložiti izvornike rješenja. Sukladno Uredbi (EU) 2016/679 Europskog parlamenta i Vijeća od 27. travnja 2016. o zaštiti pojedinaca u vezi s obradom osobnih podataka i o slobodnom kretanju takvih podataka, te Zakonu o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka („Narodne novine“ br. 42/18), prijavom na natječaj kandidat daje privolu za prikupljanje i obradu osobnih podataka iz natječajne dokumentacije u svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka. Rok za podnošenje prijave na natječaj je osam (8) dana od dana objave (23. listopada 2026.) Vlastoručno potpisane prijave s dokazima o ispunjavanju uvjeta natječaja treba dostaviti neposredno ili poštom na adresu: Industrijsko-obrtnička škola Pula, Rizzijeva 40, 52100 Pula, sa naznakom „ Za natječaj - nastavnik skupine strukovnih predmeta u području strojarstva “. Za prijavu na natječaj nije potrebno dostavljati originale niti ovjerene preslike dokumentacije, uz obvezu kandidata da nakon izbora dostavi izvornike isprava. Natječajna dokumentacija neće se vraćati kandidatima. Nepotpune i nepravodobne prijave neće se razmatrati. Kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj smatrat će se osoba koja podnese pravodobnu i potpunu prijavu i koja ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja. Sve kandidate koji su pravodobno dostavili potpunu prijavu sa svim prilozima odnosno ispravama i ispunjavaju uvjete natječaje Povjerenstvo za procjenu i vrednovanje kandidata za zapošljavanje poziva na procjenu odnosno testiranje prema odredbama Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanju u Industrijsko-obrtničkoj školi Pula, koji je dostupan na mrežnim stranicama Škole. Ako kandidat ne pristupi procjeni odnosno testiranju smatra se da je odustao od prijave na natječaj. Poziv kandidatima na razgovor Povjerenstvo za vrednovanje kandidata objavit će na mrežnoj stranici Škole najmanje tri (3) dana prije dana određenog za procjenu odnosno testiranje. Rezultati natječaja bit će objavljeni na mrežnoj stranici Škole u roku od osam (8) dana od dana donošenja odluke. KLASA: 112-02/26-01/13 URBROJ: 2168-22-26-01 Pula, 16. listopada 2026.

jobs.employer: Dječji vrtić "Morski konjić" - Scuola materna "Cavalluccio marino"
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka. 26. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (“Narodne novine” broj 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19,57/22,101/23,145/23,145/24,146/25 i 22/26.), članka 42. Statuta Dječjeg vrtića „Morski konjić“ – Scuola materna „Cavalluccio marino“ i Odluke Upravnog vijeća od 15.10.2026. Upravno vijeće, raspisuje

N A T J E Č A J

za prijem radnika na radno mjesto

ODGOJITELJ/ICA PREDŠKOLSKE DJECE

1 izvršitelja (m/ž) za rad u Dječjem vrtiću „Morski konjić“ – Scuola materna „Cavalluccio marino“, na određeno puno radno vrijeme do 31.08.2027. godine.

Uvjeti su: članak 24. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju i to:

Poslove odgojitelja djece od navršenih šest mjeseci života do polaska u osnovnu školu može obavljati osoba koja je završila studij odgovarajuće vrste za rad na radnome mjestu odgojitelja, a koji može biti:

a) preddiplomski sveučilišni studij,

b) preddiplomski stručni studij,

c) studij kojim je stečena viša stručna sprema u skladu s ranijim propisima,

d) diplomski sveučilišni studij,

e) specijalistički diplomski stručni studij.

Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu na natječaj kandidati su dužni priložiti sljedeću dokumentaciju, u presliku:

životopis,

presliku dokaza o stručnoj spremi,

potvrda o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji HZMO (ne stariju od dana objave natječaja),

uvjerenje o zdravstvenoj sposobnosti radnika (prilikom eventualnog zaposlenja kandidata poslodavac utvrđuje zdravstvenu sposobnost radnika),

uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi postupak za kazneno djelo navedeno u čl. 25. Zakona, ne starije od dana objave natječaja,

uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi postupak za prekršaj naveden u čl. 25. Zakona, ne starije od dana objave natječaja,

potvrda Centra za socijalnu skrb (prema mjestu stanovanja) da kandidatu nisu izrečene mjere iz članka 25. Zakona, ne starija od dana objave natječaja,

izjava kandidata o nepostojanju zapreka iz čl. 25. Zakona za prijem u radni odnos (vlastoručno potpisana),

izjava kandidata o suglasnosti za podvrgavanje testiranju i provjeri sposobnosti,

dokaz o državljanstvu,

presliku rodnog lista.

U skladu sa Zakonom o ravnopravnosti spolova na natječaj se mogu javiti osobe obaju spolova koje ispunjavaju propisane uvjete.

Uvjeti: Pristupnici na natječaj moraju ispunjavati uvjete iz članka 25. Zakonu o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju.

Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju na temelju posebnog zakona, u prijavi su dužni pozvati se na to pravo te dostaviti dokaze o priznavanju posebnog statusa, te dokaz o načinu prestanka radnog odnosa kod prethodnog poslodavca.

Kandidat koji može ostvariti pravo prednosti sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine, broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21), članku 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine, broj 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine, broj 84/21) te članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine, broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20), dužan se u prijavi na natječaj pozvati na to pravo te ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.

Da bi kandidat ostvario pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju, osoba iz članka 102. stavaka 1. – 3. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine, broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21) koji u trenutku odnošenja prijave ispunjava uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja te ovisno o kategoriji koja se poziva na prednost pri zapošljavanju priložiti sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine, broj 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i rješenje, odnosno potvrdu iz koje je vidljivo spomenuto pravo, te dokaz o tome na koji način je prestao radni odnos.

Da bi kandidat ostvario pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju, osoba iz članka 48. stavaka 1. – 2. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine, broj 84/21) koji u trenutku podnošenja prijave ispunjava uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja te ovisno o kategoriji koja se poziva na prednost pri zapošljavanju priložiti sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine, broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20), uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom. Dokaz o invaliditetu smatraju se javne isprave na temelju kojih se osoba može upisati u očevidnik zaposlenih osoba s invaliditetom iz članka 13. navedenog Zakona.

Prijave s traženom dokumentacijom, u zatvorenoj omotnici s naznakom “ZA NATJEČAJ-ODGOJITELJ/ICA“, potrebno je dostaviti poštom na adresu:

Dječji vrtić „Morski konjić“ – Scuola materna „Cavalluccio marino“

Brajde 31A

52465 Tar - Torre

Nepotpune i/ili nepravovremene prijave neće se razmatrati. O rezultatima izbora kandidati će biti obaviješteni najkasnije u roku od 45 dana od isteka roka za podnošenje prijave. Prije sklapanja ugovora o radu izabrani kandidat dužan je priložiti originale ili ovjerene preslike gore traženih dokumenata. Ugovor o radu se sklapa uz uvjet probnog rada u trajanju od šest mjeseci. Prilikom zapošljavanja oba spola su u ravnopravnom položaju.

Prijave na natječaj predaju se u roku od osam (8) dana od dana objave natječaja na mrežnoj stranici i oglasnoj ploči Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje, na oglasnoj ploči Dječjeg vrtića „Morski konjić“ – Scuola materna „Cavalluccio marino“, te na internetskim stranicama Dječjeg vrtića „Morski konjić“ – Scuola materna „Cavalluccio marino“ (www.dvmorskikonjic.hr).

Samom prijavom na natječaj smatrat će se da kandidat daje privolu za objavljivanjem i obradom svojih osobnih podataka.

Po raspisanom natječaju ne mora se izvršiti izbor.

Natječaj je objavljen dana 19.10.2026. i važi do 27.10.2026. godine.

KLASA: 112-01/26-02/13

URBROJ: 2163-36-1-05-26-1

Tar, 19.10.2026.

jobs.title: ODGOJITELJ/ODGOJITELJICA NA NEODREĐENO
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 26. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 146/25 i 22/26) i odluke Upravnog vijeća Dječjeg vrtića CVRKUTIĆ Oroslavje od 15. listopada 2026. godine, Upravno vijeće Dječjeg vrtića CVRKUTIĆ Oroslavje na prijedlog ravnateljice objavljuje NATJEČAJ za prijem za radno mjesto ODGOJITELJ/ICA na neodređeno vrijeme, puno radno vrijeme (40 sati tjedno) – 2 izvršitelja/ice Za prijem u radni odnos kandidati moraju ispunjavati opće uvjete za zasnivanje radnog odnosa te uvjete propisane člankom 24. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju i Pravilniku o odgovarajućoj vrsti i razini obrazovanja odgojno-obrazovnih i ostalih radnika u dječjem vrtiću („Narodne novine“ 145/24 i 62/25). Poslove odgojitelja može obavljati osoba koja je završila:
  • Sveučilišni diplomski studij odnosno ima stečeni akademski naziv Sveučilišni magistar ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja,
  • Sveučilišni prijediplomski studij odnosno ima stečeni akademski naziv Sveučilišni prvostupnik ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja ili
  • Stručni prijediplomski studij odnosno ima stečeni akademski naziv Prvostupnik ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja.
Ako se na natječaj ne javi osoba koja ispunjava prethodno navedene uvjete, poslove odgojitelja može obavljati osoba koja je završila učiteljski studij, i to: specijalistički diplomski stručni studij ili integrirani preddiplomski i diplomski studij ili četverogodišnji diplomski stručni studij primarnog obrazovanja, uz uvjet da u roku od dvije godine od dana zasnivanja radnoga odnosa stekne kvalifikaciju odgojitelja temeljem priznavanja stečenih ishoda učenja na studiju za učitelja i razlike programa za prekvalifikaciju ili dokvalifikaciju učitelja u svrhu stjecanja kvalifikacije odgojitelja. Pored navedenih uvjeta kandidati moraju ispunjavati i opće uvjete za prijem u radni odnos: 1. punoljetnost 2. zdravstvenu sposobnost za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta – uvjerenje o zdravstvenoj sposobnosti radnika (prilikom eventualnog zaposlenja kandidata poslodavac utvrđuje zdravstvenu sposobnost radnika), 3. radni odnos u dječjem vrtiću ne može zasnovati osoba koja ima zapreke definirane člankom 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 146/25 i 22/26) Kao dokaz o ispunjavanju uvjeta za prijam u radni odnos kandidati moraju uz vlastoručno potpisanu zamolbu priložiti sljedeće dokumente:
  • životopis (vlastoručno potpisan)
  • dokaz o državljanstvu - preslika
  • preslika diplome o stečenoj stručnoj spremi
  • elektronički zapis odnosno potvrda o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje
  • kao dokaz o nepostojanju zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa sukladno čl. 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju dostavljaju se sljedeći dokumenti (ne stariji od šest mjeseci)
a) uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak prema članku 25. stavak 2. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju b) uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi prekršajni postupak prema članku 25. stavak 4. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju c) potvrda nadležnog Hrvatskog zavoda za socijalni rad da kandidat nema izrečenu mjeru za zaštitu dobrobiti djeteta iz članka 25. stavak 10. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju. Isprave se prilažu u neovjerenoj preslici. Kandidat koji bude izabran dužan je prije sklapanja ugovora o radu dostaviti izvornike dokumenata. Podnošenjem prijave na natječaj kandidati daju privolu da Dječji vrtić CVRKUTIĆ Oroslavje kao voditelj obrade osobnih podataka može prikupljati, koristiti i obrađivati njihove osobne podatke u svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka, sukladno propisima o zaštiti osobnih podataka. Na natječaj se mogu prijaviti osobe oba spola. Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim zakonima, sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji („Narodne novine“ br. 121/17, 98/19 i 84/21), članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata („Narodne novine“ br. 84/21) i članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom („Narodne novine“ br. 157/13, 152/14, 39/18 i 32/20) dužna je u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti odgovarajuće isprave kao dokaz o statusu te druge dokaze sukladno posebnom zakonu kojim je uređeno to pravo te ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Poveznica za stranicu Ministarstva branitelja na kojoj su navedeni dokazi potrebni za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema Zakonu o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji („Narodne novine“ br. 121/17, 98/19 i 84/21) je: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf Poveznica za stranicu Ministarstva branitelja na kojoj su navedeni dokazi potrebni za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema Zakonu o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata („Narodne novine“ br. 84/21) je: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom („Narodne novine“ br. 157/13, 152/14, 39/18 i 32/20) uz prijavu na javni natječaj dužna je, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom te dokaz o prestanku radnog odnosa kod posljednjeg poslodavca (ugovor, rješenje, odluka i sl.) jobs.title: ODGOJITELJ/ICA
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 24. i 26. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (,,Narodne novine“, broj: 10/97., 107/07., 94/13., 98/19., 57/22., 101/23. i 22/26), članka 2. stavka 1. Pravilnika o odgovarajućoj vrsti i razini odgojno-obrazovnih i ostalih radnika u obrazovanju. dječjem vrtiću, ustanovama te drugim pravnim i fizičkim osobama koje provode programe ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja („Narodne novine“, broj: 145/24. i 62/25. – Ispravak) Dječji vrtić Radost objavljuje

NATJEČAJ

za zasnivanje radnog odnosa na temelju ugovora o radu na određeno vrijeme, puno radno vrijeme, upražnjeni poslovi na radnom mjestu;

•ODGOJITELJ/ICA, 1 izvršitelj/ica, do povratka radnice na rad

STRUČNI UVJETI:

1.Studij rani i predškolski odgoj i obrazovanje: 1.Sveučilišni diplomski studij - Sveučilišni/a magistar/magistra r anog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja 2.S veučilišni prijediplomski studij - Sveučilišni/a prvostupnik/ca ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja 3.S tručni prijediplomski studij - Prvostupnik/ca ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja 4.Stručni diplomski studij

1.Ako se na natječaj ne javi osoba koja ispunjava uvjete iz točke 1., poslove odgojitelja može obavljati osoba koja je završila učiteljski studij, i to: sveučilišni integrirani prijediplomski i diplomski studij, stručni diplomski studij ili četverogodišnji stručni studij primarnoga obrazovanja i koja je završila program za stjecanje odgojno-obrazovnih kompetencija za rad s djecom rane i predškolske dobi. 2.Ako se na natječaj ne javi osoba koja ispunjava uvjete iz točaka 1. i 2., poslove odgojitelja može obavljati osoba koja je završila učiteljski studij, i to: sveučilišni integrirani prijediplomski i diplomski studij ili stručni diplomski studij ili četverogodišnji stručni studij primarnoga obrazovanja, uz uvjet da u roku od dvije godine od dana zasnivanja radnog odnosa završi program za stjecanje odgojno-obrazovnih kompetencija za rad s djecom rane i predškolske dobi.

Osim navedenih uvjeta, kandidati/kinje moraju ispunjavati i dodatni uvjet propisan člankom 24. stavkom 2. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (zdravstvena sposobnost za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta: Odgojitelj/ica).

Uvjete za rad ispunjavaju i osobe koje su završile odgovarajući studijski program prema ranijim propisima te stekle odgovarajuću kvalifikaciju i akademski naziv u skladu s odredbama Zakona o visokom obrazovanju i znanstvenoj djelatnosti, Zakona o akademskim i stručnim nazivima i akademskom stupnju te Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju.

Opis poslova javnog radnog mjesta koji se popunjava natječajem navedeni su u Pravilniku o unutarnjem ustrojstvu dostupnom na mrežnoj stranici vrtića: https://vrtic-radost.zagreb.hr/akti-vrtica/103 .

PODACI O PLAĆI: Na temelju Kolektivnog ugovora za zaposlene u predškolskim ustanovama Grada Zagreba (Službeni glasnik Grada Zagreba, broj: 40/22., 14/23., 15/23., 1/24., 26/24., 40/24. - ispravak, 41/24., 2/25., 13/25. , 44/25. 6/26 - u daljnjem tekstu: Kolektivni ugovor ), osnovna plaća je umnožak koeficijenta složenosti poslova radnog mjesta – odgojitelj VSS 2,14, odgojitelj VŠS 2,10 i osnovice za izračun plaće u visini od 1.075,94 eura bruto, uvećan za 0,5% za svaku navršenu godinu radnog staža.

Na natječaj se mogu prijaviti osobe oba spola.

Radni odnos ne može zasnovati osobu za koju postoje zapreke za zasnivanje radnog odnosa iz članka 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju.

U svrhu prijave na natječaj kandidati/kinje dužni/e su priloženi:

1.vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu na natječaj s naznakom natječaja na koji se javljaju, 2.životopis 3.dokaz o odgovarajućoj vrsti i stupnju obrazovanja (diploma, svjedodžba ili druga javna isprava koju je izdala ovlaštena pravna osoba) 4.dokaz o državljanstvu 5.rješenje o priznavanju inozemne stručne kvalifikacije, ako se radi o inozemnoj stručnoj kvalifikaciji

U prijavi na natječaj navode se osobni podaci podnositelja/ice prijave (ime i prezime, adresa stanovanja, broj telefona/mobitela, po mogućnosti e - adresa) te naziv radnoga mjesta na koje se prijavljuje.

Isprave se prilažu u neovjerenoj preslici, a kandidat/kinja koji/a bude izabran/a dužan/na je predočiti izvornik.

Potpunom prijavom smatra se ona koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u natječaju te koja je vlastoručno potpisana.

Osoba koja nije podnijela pravodobnu ili potpunu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja, ne smatra se kandidatom/kinjom prijavljenim/om na natječaj.

Kandidat/kinja koji/a ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom zakonu, dužan/na je u prijavi pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu te ima pravo prednosti u odnosu na ostale kandidate/kinje samo pod jednakim uvjetima.

Osoba koja može ostvariti pravo prednosti:

-sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (,,Narodne novine“, broj: 121/17., 98/19., 84/21. i 156/23.), uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je priložiti osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapošljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf

-sukladno članku 47. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (,,Narodne novine“, broj: 84/21.), uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je priložiti osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapošljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf

-sukladno članku 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (,,Narodne novine“, broj: 33/92., 77/92., 27/93., 58/93., 2/94., 76/94., 108/95., 108/96., 82/01., 103/03., 148/13. i 98/19.), uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je priložiti osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i rješenje, odnosno potvrdu iz koje je vidljivo spomenuto pravo te dokaz o tome na koji način je prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca;

- sukladno članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (,,Narodne novine“, broj: 157/13., 152/14., 39/18. i 32/20.), uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta priložiti i dokaz o invaliditetu te dokaz o tome na koji način je prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca.

Kandidat/kinja predložen/a za izbor bit će pozvan/a da u primjerenom roku, a prije sklapanja ugovora o radu, dostavi isprave nadležnih tijela o postojanju/nepostojanju pojedinih zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa iz članka 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju te ispravu o zdravstvenoj sposobnosti za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta. Trošak izdavanja isprave o zdravstvenoj sposobnosti snosi Dječji vrtić Radost.

Za predloženog kandidata/kinju Dječji vrtić Radost provjerit će se po službenoj dužnosti postojanje/nepostojanje preostalih zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa iz članka 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju.

Prijave se podnose neposredno u tajništvo ili poštom na adresu: Dječji vrtić Radost, Ljubijska 79a , 10 040 Zagreb, uz naznaku: „Za natječaj – Odgojitelj/ica - ODREĐENO ''.

Rok za podnošenje prijave na natječaj je osam (8) dana od dana objave natječaja.

O rezultatima natječaja kandidati/kinje će biti obaviješteni/eu roku osam (8) dana od dana donošenja odluke o odabiru objave na mrežnoj stranici Dječjeg vrtića Radost.

Sukladno odredbama Uredbe (EU) 2016/679 Europskog parlamenta i Vijeća od 27. travnja 2016. godine te Zakona o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti osobnih podataka (Narodne novine, broj: 42/18.) prijavom na natječaj smatra se da je kandidat pristupio obradi svih podataka iz natječajne dokumentacije, a koja će se obrađivati ​​isključivo u svrhu provođenja natječajnog postupka i zapošljavanja.

Natječaj će biti objavljen na mrežnoj stranici i oglasnim pločama Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje na mrežnoj stranici i oglasnim pločama Dječjeg vrtića Radost 19.10.2026., a rok za podnošenje prijave traje do 27.10.2026.
