jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow in Computational Medicinal Chemistry for Addiction Research
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a PhD Research Fellow position in Computational Structural Biology is available at the Department of Pharmacy, Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences, within the interdisciplinary research project DECODING ADDICTION – Unraveling Individual Variability to guide Prevention, part of the UiO Life Science Convergence Environment.

Starting date as soon as possible.

The fellowship periode for three yearsA fourth year may be considered, and it will involve 25 % of other career-promoting work. Other career-promoting work may consist of teaching, supervision, and/or research assistance. This is dependent upon the qualifications of the applicant and the current needs of the department.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo. 

Place of work is at the Department of Pharmacy in the new Life Science Building, Oslo.

Job description

Addiction is a growing global crisis, and understanding individual vulnerability is critical for prevention and treatment. The DECODING ADDICTION project investigates the role of the mu-opioid receptor (OPRM1/μOR) in addiction susceptibility by studying a naturally occurring mutation (R181C) discovered in the Norwegian popu-lation. This mutation abolishes opioid receptor signaling and offers unprecedented insights into how μ-opioid signaling shapes addiction risk. This PhD project (Work Package 4) aims to use advanced computational methods to elucidate the structural and functional consequences of the R181C mutation in the μ-opioid receptor.

The PhD candidate will:

  • generate high-resolution models of wild-type and R181C mutant μ-opioid receptor based on existing crystallographic data and perform molecular docking for ligand optimization
  • perform extensive molecular dynamics (MD) simulations (AMBER, NAMD, GROMACS) in fully hydrated lipid bilayer systems to replicate physiological conditions and assess receptor conformational changes
  • conduct structural analyses including RMSD, RMSF evaluations, and hydrogen bond assessments to identify key interactions disrupted by the R181C mutation
  • perform free energy calculations using Free Energy Perturbation/Thermodynamic Integration (FEP/TI) to quantify binding affinity changes and receptor-Gi protein coupling alterations
  • investigate potential disulfide bond formation between R181C and C353 of Gi protein and collaborate closely with experimental partners in WP1-3 to interpret findings in the context of human behavioral data, mouse models, and cell biology results

The project offers a highly interdisciplinary research environment spanning computational chemistry, neuroscience, molecular biology, and psychology. The work will leverage GPU computing on the LUMI supercomputer, one of Europe’s fastest, to perform state-of-the-art molecular simulations. The position includes secondments to industry partners for complementary training in biophysical analyses (X-ray crystallography, NMR spectroscopy) and medicinal chemistry techniques. Primary supervisor is Assoc. Prof. Osman Gani, with co-supervisors Prof. Trond Vidar Hansen (organic chemistry, Dept. of Pharmacy) and Dr. Deo Pandey (molecular biology, Oslo University Hospital/Dept. of Microbiology).

What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Master’s degree  in pharmacy, computational chemistry, medicinal chemistry, bioinformatics, or a closely related field.
  • Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system
  • Strong background in molecular modeling, molecular dynamics simulations, or computer-aided drug design. Proven record of programming language through publicly available Github/Gitlab or similar repositories.
  • Experience in the cell biology lab
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English 

Desired qualifications:

  • Experience with molecular docking tools (such as Glide, AutoDOCK)
  • Experience with molecular dynamics simulation packages (AMBER, NAMD, GROMACS)
  • Familiarity with high-performance computing or GPU-accelerated simulations
  • Interest in G protein-coupled receptor (GPCR) biology, neuropharmacology, and close interdisciplinary collaboration with experimental researchers in neuroscience and molecular biology
  • Ability to teach in a Scandinavian language 

Language requirement:

  • Good oral and written communication skills in English
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements:https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

Grade requirements:The norm is as follows:

  • The average grade point for courses included in the Bachelor’s degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The average grade point for courses included in the Master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The Master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. For more information see:http://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/

What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Strong analytical skills and scientific curiosity
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in an interdisciplinary research environment
  • High level of motivation, responsibility, and perseverance
  • Clear and constructive scientific communication skills 

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.

We can offer you
  • A pleasant and stimulating work environment
  • Good welfare schemes
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Career development programmes
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Oslo’s family-friendly surroundings with their rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities
  • Salary in position as PhD Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK from 550 800 - 595 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund 
We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. We hope you will apply for the position with us.

How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter - statement of motivation and research interests
  • CV (summarizing education, positions and academic work - scientific publications)
  • Copies of the original Bachelor and Master’s degree diploma and transcripts of records ( see below)
  • Optional: Letters of recommendation
  • Documentation of English Language requirements. The appointed candidate cannot start in the position until approved documentation of English language proficiency has been submitted.
  • List of publications and academic work that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job". Foreign applicants should attach an official explanation of their University's grading system.

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.

General information

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews.Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to post doctoral and research posts at UiO (Norwegian) and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.  

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. 

The Department of Pharmacy has 130 employees. We have an active research and innovation environment based on independent research in pharmaceutical topics. The Department of Pharmacy is responsible for the popular master's degree program in pharmacy and has 350 competent and committed students.Pharmaceutical related research and education forms the base of all activities at the Department of Pharmacy. The science of pharmacy lies in the interface between the natural sciences, pharmaceutical technology, health related topics and social sciences. This interdisciplinarity is reflected both in our study programmes and in our research. 

In the planned life science building at the University of Oslo, closer collaboration with health enterprises, local government and the business sector will enhance quality and relevance in research and education of the future labour force. The building will be the heart of the first innovation district in Norway – Oslo Science City. The Department of Pharmacy will move into the new Life Science building in 2026.

Employer: TEACH DE BROC LIMITED, trading as Teach de Broc
Location: Teach de Broc, Ballybunion, Co. Kerry, V31 C971, Ireland
Start: May 2027
Contract: Full-time, six-month fixed-term
Vacancies: 1
Salary: From €18.50 gross per hour, negotiable depending on experience (€37,518 annual equivalent), paid for the six-month employment period
Hours: 39 guaranteed paid hours per week
Career level: Professional
Remote working: No
Sector: Accommodation and food service activities

ABOUT THE PROPERTY
Teach de Broc is an award-winning 16-bedroom boutique property beside Ballybunion Golf Club on Ireland’s west coast, known for refined dining and welcoming hospitality.

THE ROLE
We require an experienced Chef de Partie to manage an allocated kitchen section under the Head Chef, maintaining consistent food quality, presentation and efficient service.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Organise daily mise en place according to menus, bookings and service requirements.
• Prepare, cook and present dishes to agreed recipes, portions and standards.
• Coordinate with kitchen and front-of-house colleagues.
• Follow HACCP, food hygiene and allergen procedures.
• Maintain temperature checks, safe storage, labelling, date coding and stock rotation.
• Check deliveries, monitor stock and report shortages or quality concerns.
• Control portions and minimise food waste.
• Maintain clean, safe workstations, equipment and storage areas.
• Support junior colleagues and complete kitchen opening and closing duties.

REQUIREMENTS
• Minimum five years’ relevant professional chef experience, supported by verifiable employment references.
• Restaurant, hotel or comparable professional kitchen experience.
• Ability to manage a section and work effectively during busy service.
• Knowledge of HACCP, food hygiene and allergen controls.
• English sufficient for service communication, instructions and safety procedures.
• Strong organisation, reliability, teamwork and attention to detail.
• Availability for the full six-month contract.

Culinary qualifications, previous CDP experience and seafood preparation experience are desirable.

ACCOMMODATION
Low-cost, on-site accommodation with your own private room is available for the full employment contract, close to the workplace. Charges and any utility costs will be explained before acceptance.

EMPLOYMENT CONDITIONS
Basic pay excludes accommodation, tips, bonuses, overtime and allowances. Shifts may include mornings, evenings, weekends and public holidays. Statutory leave, breaks, rest periods and Sunday compensation apply. Additional-hours arrangements and exact contract dates will be specified in writing.

Employment is exclusively at the location above.

APPLY
Apply through the advertising platform with your CV, employment dates, qualifications and availability for May 2027. Verifiable references are required.

jobs.title: Konsulent til forretningsudvikling af efter- og videreuddannelse
jobs.description:
Vi er i gang med at samle EVU-forretning og EVU-administration i ét fælles EVU-team i Uddannelsesservice. Med den nye organisering samler vi kompetencerne og skaber en tættere sammenhæng mellem administration, data, forretningsudvikling og den strategiske udvikling af området. Vi har høje ambitioner for EVU og står derfor foran en spændende udvikling af både samarbejdsformer, processer og opgaveløsning. Derfor søger vi en ny kollega, der kan understøtte forretningsudviklingen af efter- og videreuddannelserne på tværs af Absalons faglige centre. Du bliver en del af ét samlet EVU-team, hvor vi arbejder på tværs og sammen skaber gode løsninger for studerende, virksomheder og vores interne samarbejdspartnere. Din profil Vi søger dig, der har solid erfaring med at understøtte forretningsudvikling, strategiske indsatser og ledelsesinformation. Du har styr på dine projektlederværktøjer og kan arbejde selvstændigt med data, udvikling og procesplanlægning. Det er vigtigt, at du er nysgerrig på sammenhængene omkring dine egne opgaver, den samlede værdikæde og har lyst til at bidrage til udviklingen af vores fælles EVU-område. Derudover skal du kunne genkende dig selv i følgende: Du har erfaring med at understøtte forandringsprocesser og lede projekter. Du har et skarpt blik for, hvad der kræves for at gennemføre udviklings- og forandringsopgaver i en større organisation. Du kan bistå med at tilrettelægge, facilitere og understøtte især tværgående processer og projekter - og du formår at få dem sikkert i havn. Du arbejder analytisk og udarbejder ledelsesinformation af høj kvalitet. Du har kompetencer i både kvalitativ og kvantitativ analyse og formår at indsamle og bearbejde data, identificere tendenser og omsætte dem til relevant ledelsesinformation, der kan danne grundlag for beslutninger inden for strategi og forretningsudvikling. Du trives med variation og mange samarbejdsrelationer. Du kan bevare overblikket over flere samtidige processer, prioritere dine opgaver og sætte dig ind i nye fagområder og systemer. Du kommunikerer klart, præcist og imødekommende - både skriftligt og mundtligt. Derudover forventer vi, at du har:
  • interesse for efter- og videreuddannelsesområdet. Kendskab til uddannelsessektoren og/eller det kommunale og regionale område er en fordel, men ikke et krav
  • en relevant akademisk uddannelse.
Dine arbejdsopgaver Du skal være ansvarlig for en række forskelligartede opgaver af både driftsmæssig og udviklingsorienteret karakter. Du kan f.eks. få ansvaret for: Udvikling af processer og arbejdsgange. Du bidrager til at udvikle og forbedre arbejdsprocesser, værktøjer, data og dokumenter. Vi er optagede af at skabe enklere og mere sammenhængende arbejdsgange samt at bruge digitale muligheder og data, hvor det giver værdi. Du skal derfor have lyst til at udfordre eksisterende praksis - også din egen - og være med til at omsætte nye løsninger til en hverdag, der fungerer. Data, ledelsesinformation og forretningsunderstøttelse. Du indsamler, bearbejder og følger data om EVU-området samt udvikler nøgletal og ledelsesinformation. Du bidrager til at identificere tendenser og omsætter data til viden, der kan bruges som grundlag for prioriteringer, beslutninger og den videre udvikling af EVU. Derudover kan du få koordinerende og udviklingsorienterede opgaver inden for strategi, kvalitet og forretningsudvikling. Udarbejde sagsfremstillinger, redegørelser mv. En vigtig del af dit arbejde vil være at udarbejde og kvalificere notater, mindre analyser og sagsfremstillinger i samarbejde med direktøren på området. Herefter videreformidler du disse til direktion, chefer og EVU-netværket i et klart og tydeligt sprog. Samtidig er du tovholder for et netværk af konsulenter på efter- og videreuddannelsesområdet. Fremdrift i strategiske indsatser og partnerskaber. Du skal understøtte Absalons centrale partnerskaber med kommuner og regionen. Det betyder, at du skal sikre fremdrift i de aftalte aktiviteter og løbende koordinere både internt på Absalon og med partnerorganisationerne. Du kommer også til at understøtte udvikling og implementering af forskellige indsatser i forbindelse med uddannelsesreformen, fx i forhold til udvikling af fleksible uddannelser. Dine kolleger Du bliver en del af vores nye samlede EVU-team i Uddannelsesservice. Her samler vi kompetencer inden for administration, vejledning, kontrakter, data og forretningsudvikling omkring Absalons efter- og videreuddannelser. Vi er omkring 20 medarbejdere med forskellige fagligheder og erfaringer. Vi er i gang med at skabe vores fælles arbejdsformer og udvikle samarbejdet på tværs, og som ny kollega får du derfor også mulighed for at præge, hvordan vi fremover løser opgaverne. Vi lægger vægt på et stærkt arbejdsfællesskab, hvor vi deler viden, hjælper hinanden og tager fælles ansvar for opgaverne. Samtidig har vi en uformel omgangstone og sætter pris på et godt grin og en god stemning på kontoret. Der er mulighed for op til to hjemmearbejdsdage, når det passer med opgaverne og samarbejdet i teamet. Vores fælles arbejdssted er Campus Slagelse, som ligger lige ved Slagelse Station. Uddannelsesservice består af i alt fem teams og ca. 94 kolleger. Udover EVU varetager Uddannelsesservice bl.a. optagelse, studieadministration og vejledning på Absalons professionsbachelor- og ingeniøruddannelser. Vi er en uhøjtidelig afdeling med stor faglighed og mange samarbejdsflader på tværs af Absalon. Absalon tilbyder desuden frokostordning, adgang til motionscenter og en aktiv personaleforening. Sådan ansøger ud
  • Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst på statens område.
  • Stillingerne er på fuld tid, og vi vil gerne have, at du begynder senest den 1. januar 2027.
  • Du indplaceres som akademiker og alt efter kompetencer og erfaring ligger et forventet månedligt løninterval mellem 34.150 kr. og 42.900 kr. Hertil kommer et pensionsbidrag på op til 18,07%. For en ansøger med den rette anciennitet og erfaring vil der være mulighed for ansættelse som specialkonsulent. Du kan forvente et månedligt lønniveau omkring 47.800 kr. Hertil kommer et pensionsbidrag på 18,07%. Alt efter erfaring og baggrund kan der evt. forhandles kvalifikationstillæg.
  • Har du spørgsmål til stillingen er du velkommen til at kontakte teamleder Louise Lund Kortbek på telefon 7248 1212 eller lolk@pha.dk
  • Ansøgning og relevante bilag sendes via vores rekrutteringssystem her eller ved at klikke på 'Søg stillingen' til højre på denne side senest den 2. november 2026. https://phabsalon.dk/job-i-absalon/ledige-stillinger
  • Vi forventer at afholde 1. samtaler den 13. november og 2. samtaler den 18. november. Du kan forvente en case til 2. samtalen.
Vi ønsker, at medarbejderstaben afspejler det omgivende samfund, og vi opfordrer derfor alle interesserede uanset køn, kulturel og etnisk baggrund til at søge stillingen. Om Absalon Professionshøjskolen Absalon er Region Sjællands største uddannelsesinstitution, hvor vi med vores 14 uddannelser uddanner mennesker, der med høj faglighed og professionalisme skaber værdi i det samfund, de er en del af. Vores uddannelser går tæt på den enkelte studerendes drømme og potentialer, tæt på den praksis de skal virke i og på de mennesker og fællesskaber, de skal gøre en mærkbar forskel for. I en ny sjællandsk storregion er det afgørende at have blik for både de store linjer, det lokale og det nære. De mennesker, der uddanner sig på Absalon, løfter andre mennesker og skaber muligheder og udvikling dér, hvor de bor og arbejder. Det er vores ambition at skabe praksisnære uddannelser af høj kvalitet og give de studerende de bedste forudsætninger for at udvikle sig til kompetente professionelle. Og vi vil styrke mulighederne for, at de kan skabe en karriere, der til enhver tid matcher deres faglige interesser og ambitioner - og det ansvar de tager i vores samfund.

jobs.title: Särmääjä / PressBrakeOperator
jobs.description:
Särmääjä

Etsimme asiakasyrityksellemme Ylivieskaan, Pohjois-Pohjanmaalle särmääjää. Työ on vakituinen, kokopäiväinen 2-vuorotyö ja eduksi katsomme 3-vuorovalmiuden. Käsiteltävät materiaalit ovat ohutmetallia 0,4-10mm vahvuisia, musta teräs, RST/HST, alumiini.

Asiakkaan ydinosaamista ovat ohutlevymekaaniset kokonaisuudet, suunnittelu sekä tuotekehitys.

Asiakaskuntaan kuuluu mm. kylmälaite- ja jäähdytinvalmistajia, lääketieteen alueen laitevalmistajia, tietoliikenteeseen toimijoita ja liikenteen alueen toimijoita. 


Asiakkaan avaroissa ja siisteissä tiloissa on useita levytyökeskuksia, laserleikkauskoneita ja särmäyspuristimia. Osa särmäyspuristimista on osin robotisoituina.
Amadan ja Finnpowerin särmäyskoneita on useita, (mm. Amada HFE 3i 1003 , Amada HFE 3i 2204L).

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää kokemusta särmäyksestä, hyvää matemaattista hahmotuskykyä, sekä kykyä lukea ja tulkita teknisiä piirustuksia. Varsinaista ohjelmointitaitoa ei edellytetä, sillä ne ovat valmiina, silti korjauksia ja säätöjä tulisi osata tehdä itsenäisesti. Arvostamme tarkkaa ja huolellista työskentelyotetta sekä halua oppia uusia asioita ja kehittää omaa osaamistaan.

Odotamme sinulta:
Kokemusta särmäyksestä (välttämätön)
Kykyä lukea ja tulkita teknisiä piirustuksia, oma-aloitteisuutta ja vastuullista työotetta, halu oppia ja omaksua uusia asioita, tarkkuutta ja huolellisuutta päivittäisessä työssä
Suomen ja/tai englannin kielen taito

Eduksi (mutta ei vaadita)
Muiden koneiden kuten levytyökeskusten, laserleikkauskoneiden ja automatisoitujen CNC-koneiden kanssa toimiminen. 
Osaaminen hitsaus-, pintakäsittely- tai kokoonpanopuolen työstä

Tarjoamme
vakituisen ja kokoaikaisen työn
kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen osaamisen mukaan
työehtosopimuksen mukaiset työehdot
mahdollisuuden työskennellä vakaassa ja kehittyvässä konepajayrityksessä
mukavan työyhteisön ja pitkäaikaisen työmahdollisuuden
tarvittaessa apua majoituksen järjestämisessä

Kiinnostuitko?
Jätä hakemuksesi oheisen linkin kautta mahdollisimman pian. Kerro hakemuksessasi erityisesti, millaisia tuotteita tai rakenteita olet maalannut, mitä maalausmenetelmiä ja maaleja olet käyttänyt sekä millaisessa teollisuusympäristössä olet työskennellyt.

Haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana ja paikka voidaan täyttää heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Mikäli olet jo täyttänyt VPS:n sähköisen hakulomakkeen, käy liittämässä se tunnuksillasi tähän paikkaan. Voit halutessasi liittää lomakkeeseen myös vapaamuotoisen hakemuksen ja ansioluettelon. Hakuun liittyvät kysymykset p. 0504623615 tai sähköpostitse sanna.rinkinen@vps.fi  . Huom! hakemukset kotisivujen lomakkeen kautta ei sähköpostiin.

VPS Henkilöstöpalvelu kuuluu VPS Yhtiöihin ja on vuonna 1987 perustettu suomalainen perheyritys. Olemme henkilöstövuokraukseen ja rekrytointeihin erikoistunut toimija, joka palvelee asiakkaitaan koko Suomessa sekä kansainvälisesti. VPS on HELA Henkilöstöpalveluyritysten Liiton jäsen.
Toimintamme perustuu eettisyyteen, laatuun ja hyvään asiakaspalveluun. Tunnuslauseemme on "Valitsemme parhaat sinulle." 
Lisätietoja yrityksestämme: www.vps.fi

**


CNC Press Brake Operator

We are looking for an experienced CNC Press Brake Operator for our client company in Ylivieska, Northern Ostrobothnia, Finland. This is a permanent, full-time position involving two-shift work. Willingness to work three shifts is considered an advantage.

The materials processed include thin sheet metal with thicknesses ranging from 0.4 to 10 mm, including carbon steel, stainless steel, acid-resistant stainless steel and aluminium.

Our client specialises in demanding sheet metal assemblies, engineering, design and product development.

The companys customers include manufacturers of refrigeration and cooling equipment, medical devices, telecommunications equipment and transportation-related products.

The client offers a spacious, clean and modern production environment equipped with several CNC punching machines, laser cutting machines and press brakes. Some of the press brakes are partially robotised.

The factory operates several Amada and Finnpower press brakes, including the Amada HFE 3i 1003 and Amada HFE 3i 2204L.


Requirements

To succeed in this position, you must have previous experience in CNC press brake operation, good mathematical and spatial reasoning skills, and the ability to read and interpret technical drawings.

Advanced programming skills are not required, as the programs are already prepared. However, you must be able to independently make necessary adjustments, corrections and modifications to existing programs and machine settings.

We value a precise and careful approach to work, initiative, responsibility, and a willingness to learn new skills and further develop your professional expertise.

Previous experience in press brake operation is essential. You should be confident in reading technical drawings, working independently, maintaining dimensional accuracy and ensuring high-quality results.

Good communication skills in Finnish and/or English are required.

Advantage (but not required) Experience with other sheet metal machinery, such as CNC punching machines, laser cutting machines and automated CNC equipment, is considered an advantage. Additional skills in welding, surface treatment or mechanical assembly are also beneficial.

What We Offer
permanent full-time employment
Work under the Finnish Technology Industry Collective Agreement (TES)
competitive salary based on experience and skills
stable long-term employment in a growing manufacturing company
supportive and professional working environment
Assistance with accommodation if needed

Interested?
Submit your application through the application link as soon as possible. In your application, please tell us what types of products or structures you have painted, which painting methods and coating systems you have used, and what kind of industrial environments you have worked in.

We will interview suitable candidates already during the application period, and the position may be filled as soon as the right candidate is found.

If you have already completed VPSs online application form, log in with your credentials and link your existing application to this position. You may also attach a free-form app

jobs.title: Kokkeelev søges til Restaurant Abigail i Axel Towers
jobs.description:
Vil du lære kokkefaget i et køkken, hvor råvaren, håndværket og detaljen er i centrum?

Restaurant Abigail i Axel Towers søger en ambitiøs kokkeelev, der ønsker mere end blot en elevplads. Vi søger dig, der har en oprigtig interesse for gastronomi og ønsker at udvikle dit håndværk i et professionelt køkken med høje ambitioner.

Hos Abigail arbejder vi med respekt for råvaren, sæsonen og det gode håndværk. Vi tror på præcision, nysgerrighed og på, at de bedste resultater skabes, når stærke teknikker kombineres med kreativitet og forståelse for smag.

EN ELEVPLADS MED AMBITIONER

Som kokkeelev hos Abigail bliver du en del af køkkenet fra første dag.

Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med vores kokke og får mulighed for at udvikle dig inden for både klassiske teknikker og moderne gastronomi. Du bliver udfordret, får ansvar og lærer at forstå hele processen bag en ret – fra den enkelte råvare og den første mise en place til den færdige servering.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Sæsonens bedste råvarer

  • Klassiske og moderne tilberedningsteknikker

  • Saucer, fonde, fermentering og konservering

  • Smagssammensætning, teksturer og balance

  • Præcision og æstetik i anretningen

  • Mise en place og service på højt niveau

  • Udvikling og tilsmagning af nye retter

  • Råvareudnyttelse og respekt for hele produktet

VI SØGER DIG, DER VIL NOGET MED DIT FAG

Du behøver ikke at kunne det hele endnu. Det vigtigste er, at du vil lære det.

Vi søger en elev med gastronomisk nysgerrighed, disciplin og ambitioner. En person, der lægger mærke til detaljerne, stiller spørgsmål og ønsker at forstå, hvorfor vi gør tingene, som vi gør.

Du trives med høje forventninger og ser feedback som en naturlig del af din udvikling.

For os handler talent ikke kun om teknik. Det handler også om arbejdsdisciplin, nysgerrighed, ydmyghed over for håndværket og lysten til hele tiden at blive bedre.

DIN UDVIKLING ER EN DEL AF VORES AMBITION

Hos Abigail ønsker vi ikke blot at uddanne kokke – vi ønsker at udvikle dygtige gastronomiske håndværkere.

Derfor får du mulighed for løbende at tage mere ansvar, arbejde med forskellige områder af køkkenet og opbygge en solid forståelse for både råvarer, teknikker og restaurantdrift.

Til gengæld forventer vi, at du møder ind med engagement, nysgerrighed og lysten til at udvikle dig.

Du bliver en del af et ambitiøst køkkenteam og får din daglige arbejdsplads på Restaurant Abigail i Axel Towers – midt i København.

Er gastronomi mere end bare et arbejde for dig?

Så vil vi gerne høre fra dig.

Send os din ansøgning og CV, og fortæl lidt om, hvorfor du har valgt kokkefaget, og hvor du gerne vil hen med din gastronomiske karriere.

Vi glæder os til at byde den rette person indenfor i køkkenet på Abigail.

jobs.title: Research fellow (University Researcher) in AI for Population Health and Genomics
jobs.description: Research fellow (University Researcher) in AI for Population Health and GenomicsThe Faculty of Science and the Finnish Institute for Molecular Medicine Finland (FIMM), HiLIFE at the University of Helsinki invite applications for a joint (50%:50%) position asRESEARCH FELLOW (UNIVERSITY RESEARCHER) IN AI FOR POPULATION HEALTH AND GENOMICSfor a fixed-term appointment of maximum 4 years with starting date as soon as possible.POSITION DESCRIPTIONThe position relates to the Sustainable Wellbeing Across Lifespan (SWAN) (https://www.swan-helsinkiuni.net/) research action that conducts cutting-edge research to promote health span by identifying individual risks and susceptibilities, aiming to clarify mechanisms of degeneration across the lifespan and exploring new approaches to detecting, monitoring and treating remodeled metabolism associated with ageing.The candidate is expected to develop an independent research program within this scope, focusing on methodological innovation and the application of modern AI approaches to large-scale biomedical data. Research topics may include foundation models for longitudinal electronic health records and genomics, multimodal learning integrating health records with molecular data, causal representation learning, in-context learning and amortized inference for healthcare decision-making, and AI-assisted scientific discovery workflows.The work will be done together with the Ganna Lab (https://www.dsgelab.org/) at FIMM and the Probabilistic Machine Learning Lab (https://www.helsinki.fi/en/researchgroups/probabilistic-machine-learning; groups of Acerbi and Klami) at the Department of Computer Science, aligning with concurrent projects developing foundation models for healthcare. The groups are active members of the ELLIS Institute Finland (https://www.ellisinstitute.fi/), providing opportunities for collaboration with leading researchers in artificial intelligence across Finland and Europe.The position offers access to globally unique research resources, including nationwide longitudinal health records from Finland covering more than five billion healthcare events, FinnGen with genomic data from over 500,000 participants, and extensive multi-omics datasets including proteomics and single-cell transcriptomics. Researchers also benefit from access to world-class computing infrastructure through CSC and LUMI, one of Europe's most powerful supercomputers.RESPONSIBILITIESThe appointed researcher is expected to pursue independent research on methodological innovation in developing and applying AI methods, in collaboration with existing research groups at the university, and will have the opportunity to be part of ELLIS Institute Finland activities. They will also participate in university-wide activities advancing the use of AI in scientific research, together with other researchers working in the intersection of AI and other scientific disciplines.The daily working activities of the appointed researcher will be split between the Faculty of Science and FIMM. Opportunities for contribution to teaching (up to 5-10% of annual working time) will be provided.QUALIFICATIONSWe require a doctoral degree and postdoctoral research experience in artificial intelligence, machine learning, or computational statistics, with demonstrated interest in applications to population health and/or human genetics.The candidates need to have: * A doctoral degree in a suitable field * Research activity after PhD (typically 2-4 years of postdoctoral research), ideally with evidence of independent research contributions, ability to lead a research group, experience in research funding acquisition, and public engagement. * Scientific competence in developing and/or applying artificial intelligence methods with proven publication record in scientific venues in the field. We expect publication record in top-tier venues in AI and machine learning (e.g. NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, or similar) and/or publications with clear AI contributions in leading biomedical journals (e.g. Nature Genetics, Nature Medicine, Nature Machine Intelligence or similar). * Personal research interest that relates to the scope and topic of the position and connects to existing research groups at the University of Helsinki.WHAT WE OFFERUniversity of Helsinki is an equal opportunity employer and offers an attractive and diverse workplace with a variety of development opportunities and benefits. The appointees monthly salary varies between 4800-6000€ depending on their previous experience and qualifications. The employment contract will include a probationary period of six months.The appointee is expected to reside in Finland while employed by the University of Helsinki. International staff are supported in relocating to Finland.HOW TO APPLYPlease submit your application, together with the required attachments, through the University of Helsinki Recruitment System via the link "Apply now" (Hae nyt). Use your current email address to register to the Recruitment System. The closing date for applications is 16 November 2026.The following documents in English are required and must be included in the application:1) A curriculum vitae2) List of publications3) An accompanying 2–5-page document covering both qualifications for the Research Fellow level, and description of the planned research.If you are invited to an interview, you will be asked contact details of 2 referees.FURTHER INFORMATIONFurther information about the positions and the research project may be obtained from Professor Arto Klami at the Faculty of Science (arto.klami(at)helsinki.fi), and from Professor Andrea Ganna at FIMM (andrea.ganna(at)helsinki.fi).

jobs.title: System Responsible, Owners Supply
jobs.description: Oletko sinä tiimimme seuraava huippuosaaja?Haemme nyt Systeemivastuullista Tilaajan toimitusten koordinointiin liittymään Architectural Accommodation osastolle, joka toimii osana Hotel Design -yksikköä.Tule mukaan suunnittelemaan ja toteuttamaan maailman edistyksellisimpiä risteilyaluksia ja jätä kädenjälkesi laivanrakennuksen historiaan! Tähän kuuluvat hytit, hyttialueet, julkiset tilat (kuten teatterit, ravintolat ja miehistön julkiset tilat), hotellin palvelutekniset tilat ja arkkitehtoniset ulkoalueet. Yksikön vastuulla on toteuttaa asiakkaamme toimittaman arkkitehtimateriaalin design, sääntöjen, määräysten ja sovitun tason sallimissa puitteissa. Vastaamme myös eri järjestelmien reitityksen, sijainnin ja sijoittelun suunnittelusta sekä rungon suunnitteluun tarvittavien aukkojen koordinoinnista.Architectural Accommodation vastaa arkkitehtonisista systeemeistä ja sisustusalueiden perussuunnittelun koordinoimisesta. Lisäksi ryhmällä on ADA-, luovutusdokumentaatio-, IHM-, 3D- ja Sustainability spesialistit.Osana Architectural Accommodation osastoa Tilaajan (asiakkaan) toimitusten koordinointitiimimme vastaa tilaajan toimittamien materiaalien ja laitteiden tietojen sekä toimitusten koordinoinnista osana laivan perussuunnittelua.Tehtävänkuvaus:Tiedon- ja dokumentaationhallinta: Keräät ja ylläpidät tilaajan toimituksiin liittyviä tuotetietoja, teknisiä dokumentteja ja asennusohjeita telakan järjestelmissä. Luot ja ylläpidät materiaali- ja tuotetietoja telakan järjestelmissä.Toimitusten ja aikataulujen seuranta: Varmistat, että materiaalit ovat käytettävissä oikeaan aikaan laivan varustelua varten ottaen huomioon sopimusvelvoitteet ja kustannustehokkuuden.Sidosryhmätyöskentely: Toimit tiiviissä yhteistyössä asiakkaan, telakan eri osastojen, aluerakentajien sekä osallistut neuvotteluihin.Prosessien kehittäminen: Vastaat oman vastuualueesi ennakoinnista ja prosessien kehitystoimenpiteistä useissa samanaikaisissa laivaprojekteissa.Mitä odotamme sinulta:Haemme tiimiimme aktiivista henkilöä, joka kykenee toimimaan tehokkaana ja positiivisena linkkinä niin oman ryhmän, kuin muiden osastojen, asiakkaan ja aluerakentajan välillä. Hallitset hyvin aikataulutuksen ja pystyt toimimaan samanaikaisesti usean eri tahon kanssa itsenäisesti.Organisointi- ja projektitaitoja: Kykyä hallita aikatauluja, priorisoida omaa ajankäyttöä ja viedä avoimia asioita maaliin hektisessä moniprojektiympäristössä.Vuorovaikutus- ja neuvottelutaitoja: Aktiivista, rohkeaa ja ratkaisukeskeistä otetta asiakasrajapinnassa toimimiseen. Kykyä pitää eri osapuolet ajan tasalla ja varmistaa, että sovitut asiat myös toteutuvat.Teknistä ymmärrystä: Soveltuvaa teknistä koulutusta (esim. korkeakoulututkinto) sekä kykyä ymmärtää teknisiä vaatimuksia, piirustuksia ja data sheet -dokumentteja. Eduksi on, että sinulla on kokemusta projektikoordinoinnista.Ohjelmisto- ja kielitaitoa: Excelin ja muiden Office-työkalujen hallintaa sekä hyvää suullista ja kirjallista englannin kielen taitoa. SAP-, Kronodoc/Wave- ja AutoCAD/3D-osaaminen sekä laivanrakennusalan tuntemus katsotaan eduksi.Huomioithan, että edellytämme valitulta henkilöltä hyväksyttyä huumausainetestiä sekä terveystarkastuksessa todettua sopivuutta työsuhteen tehtäviin.Mitä rooli tarjoaa sinulle?Mahdollisuuden työskennellä keskeisessä roolissa asiakkaan, telakan ja aluerakentajien rajapinnassa.Monipuolisen ja vastuullisen tehtäväkentän kansainvälisessä toimintaympäristössä.Mahdollisuuden kehittyä laivanrakennuksen asiantuntijaksi kokeneiden osaajien tukemana.Kannustavan ja yhteistyöhön perustuvan työyhteisön, jossa pääset vaikuttamaan toimintatapojen ja prosessien kehittämiseen.Kysyttävää:Taru Rein, Head of Team, Architectural Accommodation, Hotel Design Department, puh.+358408261866 (Soittoajat klo 8-16 välillä). Email: taru.rein@meyerturku.fi [taru.rein@meyerturku.fi]Miksi tulla meille töihin?Pääset työskentelemään laivanrakennuksen huipulla. Maailman edistyksellisimmät risteilyalukset suunnitellaan ja rakennetaan Meyer Turun telakalla. Meidät tunnetaan huipputeknologisesta osaamisestamme, monialaisesta tuotannostamme sekä innovatiivisista ratkaisuistamme, jotka vievät koko laivanrakennusalaa eteenpäin. Tilauskantamme ulottuu pitkälle tulevaisuuteen. Vuonna 2025 liikevaihtomme oli 2,1 miljardia euroa ja työntekijöitä oli noin 2 300.Olet osa huipputekijöiden porukkaa. Meillä on osaamista, jota ei löydy mistään muualta. Telakallamme on yli 450 ammattia, ja olemme kaikki laivanrakentajia – jokaisen työpanosta tarvitaan yhteisen päämäärän saavuttamiseen.Saat myötätuulta urallesi. Kannustamme työntekijöitämme kehittymään, oppimaan uutta ja tarttumaan tilaisuuksiin. Mahdollistamme pitkät työurat: uusia, mielenkiintoisia työtehtäviä löytyy usein oman organisaatiomme sisältä.Työsuhde-edut ovat kohdallaan. Telakan oma työterveysasema tarjoaa monipuolisia palveluja, apua ja tukea koko työurasi ajan. Vapaa-ajalla voit käydä Meyer Turun kuntosalilla, osallistua monipuolisten harrastusryhmiemme toimintaan tai käyttää liikunta- ja kulttuurietuja muihin harrastuksiisi.

jobs.title: Kotisiivooja Ilomantsiin
jobs.description: Haluaisitko tehdä merkityksellistä ja joustavaa osa-aikatyötä apua tarvitsevien sympaattisten asiakkaiden, kuten ikäihmisten kanssa? Saatat olet tuleva helpperimme! Olit sitten opiskelija, eläkeläinen tai etsit muuten vain osa-aikatyötä, tässä roolissa ratkaisee innokkuus ja aito halu auttaa suurella sydämellä!Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden, lasten ja oikeastaan ihan kaiken ikäisten apua tarvitsevien kotipalveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys. Tarjoamme iloa ja turvaa asiakkaidemme arkeen ja mottomme on: autamme kuin omaa äitiämme tai isäämme.Mikä on helpperi? Helpperi on henkilö, joka tarjoaa arjen apua, seuraa ja/tai tukee kodin puhtaanapidossa omaa nimettyä avustettavaa henkilöä, kuten ikäihmistä. Helpperin työ voi sisältää avustajan tehtäviä, kuten asiakkaan tukemista kaikenlaisissa arjen askareissa, kuten ulkoilussa, kauppareissuilla, roskien viemisessä tai ihan vain kahvitellen yhdessäolon ja jutustelun merkeissä. Etsimme myös avustajien lisäksi siivooja-helppereitä, joiden työtehtäviin kuuluu ammatillinen kotisiivous ja ikkunanpesu. Ajan myötä helpperistä ja asiakkaasta tulee usein jopa ystäviä työskentelyn myötä.Helpperin työtä voivat tehdä kaikki yli 18-vuotiaat opiskelijoista eläkeläisiin. Tärkeintä on reipas työote ja aito halu auttaa.Mitä helpperin työ vaatii? Sitä, että palat halusta auttaa. Avustajan työ ei vaadi muita erityisiä taitoja. Riittää, että haluat viettää aikaa apua tarvitsevien kanssa ja tehdä omalla toiminnallasi heidän arjestaan parempaa ja helpompaa. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat myös hyvin joustavat. Siivooja-helppereiltä edellytämme kokemusta puhtaanapidon alalta.Mikä on parasta helpperin työssä? Kysyimme tätä helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:- "Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa." - "Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne." - "Hembyn yhteisöön kuuluminen." Helpperinä saat:- Oman nimetyn asiakkaan, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana - Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun tai osa-aikatyön ohelle. Tyypillinen työaika on 1-2 kertaa viikossa muutaman tunnin ajan. - Kilpailukykyisen tuntipalkan: 13,20-15,98 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset. - Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro-helpperiksi tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi! Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen.

jobs.title: CTS/BMS teknikker - Project Technician
jobs.description:
Er du vores nye CTS/BMS-tekniker?

Skal du være med til at fremtidssikre og energioptimere Danmarks bygninger?

Hos Nordic Facility Solutions ApS oplever vi en stærk efterspørgsel på vores løsninger inden for bygningsautomation, energioptimering og teknisk rådgivning. Derfor søger vi en dygtig og engageret CTS/BMS-tekniker / Project Technician, som vil være med til at levere kompromisløs kvalitet til vores kunder.

Vil du have en fleksibel hverdag med frihed under ansvar, stærk faglig sparring og mulighed for at sætte dit eget præg på projekterne? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter!

Dine primære opgaver

Som vores nye tekniker får du en alsidig og selvstændig rolle, hvor du arbejder on-site hos vores kunder. Du bliver en nøgleperson i at sikre, at bygningernes tekniske anlæg kører optimalt og energirigtigt.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil bl.a. omfatte:

  • Idriftsættelse og programmering: Opstart, konfiguration og indregulering af nye og eksisterende CTS/BMS-anlæg.

jobs.title: Associate Professor in Public Health: Children and Young People
jobs.description:
At the National Institute of Public Health (NIPH), University of Southern Denmark (SDU), a position as Associate Professor in Public Health is hereby advertised with a focus on interdisciplinary, qualitative studies of children’s and young people’s health and well-being, commencing on 15 April 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.About your future research environment  

The National Institute of Public Health (NIPH) is part of the University of Southern Denmark and is located in Copenhagen. As a national public health institute, we conduct research to improve public health in Denmark and Greenland. At the same time, we contribute internationally to the development of knowledge, theories and methods in the field of public health.

We offer an inspiring research environment in the heart of Copenhagen with skilled and dedicated colleagues from diverse research and educational backgrounds. Here, you will have the opportunity for academic exchange and further development of your own research areas, as well as participation in national and international networks. The position is anchored in the research group Health Promotion and Interventions, which conducts research on interventions addressing public health issues and works with methodological and theoretical challenges related to the design and evaluation of intervention and implementation studies. Our research concerns children, young people and families, as well as vulnerable and disadvantaged groups, and takes place in a range of settings, including daycare institutions, primary and lower secondary schools, upper secondary education, the healthcare system, municipal services, supermarkets and local communities.  You will actively participate in the daily activities of the research group and work closely with other researchers at NIPH.  

The duties include research, teaching and dissemination within the institute’s areas of expertise, including:  - Children’s and young people’s health, well-being and everyday life- The significance of digital media for children’s and young people’s lives and health- Health promotion and implementation research in daycare institutions, schools and upper secondary education- Interdisciplinary, practice-oriented research and development projects, including process evaluation- Advanced qualitative methods, including ethnography, interviews, focus groups and child-centred approaches- Teaching and supervision at bachelor’s and master’s level, including qualitative methods, children’s and young people’s health, and implementation- Preparation of applications for external funding as well as project management and coordination- Contributions to the further development of the research environment, including method development and research group activities The following qualifications are highly valued:  You have established yourself as a qualified researcher within qualitative methods, children’s and young people’s health, and intervention and implementation research, and you possess strong research and teaching qualifications at a high level. You have a relevant publication profile and extensive experience in disseminating research to researchers, practitioners, and other target groups. You have broad collaborative networks and experience in research collaboration with practitioners. As a person, you are dedicated and possess strong communication skills. You are able to build trusting relationships with students, colleagues, and external partners alike. As a teacher, you communicate up-to-date, relevant knowledge in an engaging, clear and understandable way, and as a supervisor you are skilled, inspiring, and supportive.  Qualifications  - A PhD degree in Public Health, Education, Sociology, Anthropology or a related field- Experience with intervention and implementation research- Documented experience in research on children’s and young people’s health- A strong profile within qualitative research- Experience in collaborating with practitioners, exchanging knowledge and disseminating research- Experience in national and international research collaboration- Documented teaching experience at university level and experience supervising students (e.g. bachelor’s or master's students)- Proficiency in Danish and English at a high level, both orally and in writing- Documented experience with scientific publications within relevant research areas 

Further information regarding the position can be obtained from:  Research Leader Susan Andersen,  mailto:suan@sdu.dk

Terms and conditions of employment  Appointment as an Associate Professor is for a fixed term of three years, commencing on 15 April 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.Appointment to the position will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state with the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for associate professor as described herein. Please check links for more information on salary (only available in Danish) and taxation.

The person employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a self-organiser.

The assessment and evaluation processShortlisting may be used in the assessment process. Please note that only shortlisted applicants will receive an assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee and the shortlisted applicants will receive the part of the evaluation that concerns them. The committee may request additional information, and if so, it is the responsibility of the applicants to provide the necessary material. Interviews and tests may form part of the overall assessment carried out by the appointment committee.  Based on information from the entire recruitment process, the Head of Institute will decide which applicant is offered the position. 

The application

Applicants are encouraged to read the information "How to apply" before applying. 

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include:

  • Motivated application

  • Curriculum vitae

  • Master’s degree and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (copy of original + verified English translation)

  • Teaching portfolio

  • Research plan, including an account of your own research and preferably a vision for future research 

  • A complete list of publications

  • Up to six of the most relevant publications. Please attach one PDF file per publication. In cases of co-authorship, a co-author declaration must be submitted as part of the PDF file.

  • Reference letters/references may also be included

  • A statement of other qualifications relevant to the position.

We request files in pdf-format no more than 5 MB per file. All pdf-files must be unlocked and allow merging and may not be password protected. Documents should not contain a CPR number (civil registration number) – in this case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

UPLOAD GUIDE: Motivated application shall be uploaded as ‘Cover letter’, Curriculum Vitae shall be uploaded as ‘CV’. All other documents shall be uploaded as ‘Miscellaneous documents’.

If the application does not meet the requirements mentioned above, the faculty may reject your application without further notice. Applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated.

If you experience technical problems, please contact mailto:hcm-support@sdu.dkApplication deadline 18 November 2026 at 23.59 (CET) 

We recommend that as an international applicant, you take the time to visit Work in Denmark where you will find information and facts about moving to, working and living in Denmark, as well as the International Staff Office at SDU.  The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding society and therefore encourages all qualified candidates, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.  

About SDU  The University of Southern Denmark was founded to create value for and together with society. Whether our contribution comes in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education, or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by nurturing talent and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops, and recruits talented individuals. At the same time, we must ensure consistently high quality in all our activities, which can only be achieved with the right people.  The university’s researchers, teachers, students, managers, and technical-administrative staff constitute the foundation of our success.

jobs.title: Are you a Flight Instructor? Explore Multiple Career Paths at Greybird, no matter your level.
jobs.description:
GreyBird Pilot Academy is expanding and is looking for Flight Instructors to join our team fulltime or parttime in Denmark.

Are you passionate about training and developing the next generation of commercial pilots? Do you thrive in a professional aviation environment where you can combine flight instruction with classroom and simulator-based teaching?

Three profile opportunities

Whether you are a newly graduated or an experienced Flight Instructor, already hold CRI/SPA privileges, or are ready to take the next step through our sponsored development program, we offer exciting opportunities to build your aviation career while helping future pilots achieve their goals:

Career Path 1: Flight Instructor DK summer / Spain winther

As a Flight Instructor, your primary responsibility will be delivering flight training onboard our aircraft. Depending on operational needs, you may also conduct simulator sessions and classroom-based theoretical instruction.

You will guide students throughout their training journey and help ensure the highest standards of pilot education.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI

  • Set to have a split base between Denmark in the summer and Spain in the winter

  • Based in either DK or Spain

Read more and apply here

Career Path 2: Flight Instructor – Sponsored CRI/SPA Program

About the Role

This position is designed for pilots who meet the requirements for CRI/SPA training but have not yet obtained the qualification.

As a Flight Instructor, you will deliver flight training, simulator instruction, and classroom teaching while participating in our sponsored development pathway.

Sponsored Development Opportunity

GreyBird will sponsor the CRI/SPA training required for the role if you meet the eligibility criteria below.

To be considered for sponsorship for a full-time position based at Aarhus Airport in Denmark, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Experience as PIC on MEP aircraft

  • Meet EASA FCL requirements for:

  • CRI/SPA ME, or

  • IRI MEP

Read more and apply here

Career Path 3: Flight Instructor CRI/SPA/(ME) (fulltime / or flexible planned partime)

About the Role

This position is aimed at experienced instructors already holding CRI/SPA qualifications.

You will primarily conduct flight training and may also deliver simulator and classroom instruction as part of our integrated training programs.

For candidates with these qualifications, GreyBird offers a full-time position or a flexible employment for candidates who are interested in a combination of working as an instructor at GreyBird and an airline job or commute between residence and Aarhus airport.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • CRI/SPA qualification (mandatory)

  • ME qualification (preferred but not required)

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI)

Read more and apply here

Ready for Take-Off?

If you meet the requirements for one of the three career paths, we encourage you to apply for the position that matches your current qualifications.

Join GreyBird Pilot Academy and help shape the future of aviation.

We can’t wait to hear from you.

Relocation: Candidates must be willing to relocate and live within commuting distance of our base in Aarhus, DK fulltime or parttime depending on the position.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer (Ruby), Create: Change Record
PhD Research Fellowship in Circular Battery Strategies
jobs.description:
About the position

Center for Research on Digitalization and Sustainability (CREDS), part of Inland School of Business and Social Sciences, University of Inland Norway (INN), invites candidates to apply for a three-year PhD research fellowship. The position is connected to the field of innovation studies with a specific focus on sustainability transitions, circular economy, business model change and value chains related to electric vehicle (EV) batteries in the context of energy storage and mobility. This may include research on the circular resource flows, reuse and recycle strategies, and competing end-of-life pathways for batteries and battery materials. 

Admission to INN's PhD program, Innovation in Services in the Public and Private Sectors (INSEPP), is a condition for employment as a research fellow. The candidate is expected to participate actively in INSEPP’s activities. After commencement, the candidate must apply for admission to the PhD programme within three months. An agreement for admission to the PhD programme must be in place within six months after commencement. 

As a PhD research fellow, you will be an integral part of CREDS and actively contribute to one or both of its research groups. In addition, the candidate will be employed at a department of the Business School. The position preferably commences as soon as possible, and will conclude with the award of the Degree of Doctor upon successfully completing the program. 

The position is based at CREDS in Innlandet Science Park in Kongsvinger. A high degree of on-site presence is expected. 

For further information, please contact: 

  • CREDS Professor Johan Kask, +47 62 43 01 82, johan.kask@inn.no  
  • CREDS Director and Professor Bård Tronvoll, +47 90 78 55 68, bard.tronvoll@inn.no  
  • Head of INSEPP PhD Program Marit Engen, +47 61 28 81 07, marit.engen@inn.no 
About the project

Project overview 

The PhD research fellow will join an international team of researchers at CREDS, Inland School of Business and Social Sciences. We seek a highly motivated candidate to research circular battery strategies and future applications from a business and innovation perspective. CREDS’s overarching academic objective is accelerating research on the transitions enabling sustainable businesses and societies. The primary focus is to understand transitions at the level of ecosystems and markets and at the intersection between digitization and sustainability, for instance linked to new or changed business models, value chains and practices. 

The candidate’s PhD project should address how scarce resources in circular value chains related to energy and mobility are organized and governed across competing end-of-life pathways. Relevant topics include sustainable value creation, reuse and repair strategies, recycling systems, and business models that extend the useful life of batteries and battery materials. The project may examine how such arrangements work in practice, how they develop over time, and how different pathways can be assessed in relation to sustainability, loop extension, efficiency, resilience, and other relevant criteria. It may also focus on market formation, ecosystem dynamics, governance arrangements, power relations, and the role of technology in handling resource tensions across systems, as well as on how firms and other actors develop circular strategies under competing demands, regulatory change, and uncertainty about future resource use. One particularly relevant empirical example is end-of-life EV batteries, where tensions may arise between reusing or repurposing batteries for second-life energy storage and recycling materials back into battery production or other industrial uses. Norway provides a promising context for studying such issues due to its early and extensive adoption of battery-electric vehicles. 

Candidates are encouraged to define their own research design within this theme. This includes developing the specific research questions, theoretical perspective, empirical focus, and methodological approach in dialogue with the supervisory team and the academic environment at CREDS. A broad range of methodological approaches is relevant for the theme, including qualitative case studies, optimization models, system dynamics modelling, and agent-based modelling. Please note that the project may later be modified in accordance with the supervisors’ advice and the academic research agenda of CREDS. The successful candidate will have a primary supervisor among CREDS’ academic staff.

Qualifications
  • The candidate must have a master’s degree and thesis on a relevant topic. Relevant academic backgrounds may include business and management, innovation studies, energy systems, industrial ecology, system dynamics, systems modelling, sustainability transitions, science and technology studies, topic-related forms of engineering, and other related interdisciplinary fields. 
  • The master's degree must normally constitute 120 ECTS credits. INN’s PhD regulations require that the qualifying education includes a master’s thesis of 30 ECTS. As a rule, the average grade at master’s level must be B. 
  • The qualifying degree(s) must be awarded from institutions in Norway, the EU/EEA or Switzerland, or from an international institution accredited by AACSB, AMBA and/or EQUIS. Where applicable, candidates should specify such accreditation in the application.
  • Candidates who have not yet obtained the master’s degree at the time of application may apply. In this case, candidates must have submitted their master’s thesis by the application deadline. Temporary transcripts and the master’s thesis must be submitted with the application. The final diploma must be available by the time of employment. 
  • Candidates with a master’s degree from a university abroad must attach “Recognition of foreign higher education” from NOKUT. Instructions for obtaining this assessment are available from NOKUT, https://hkdir.no/en/foreign-education/education-from-outside-ofnorway/recognition-of-foreign-higher-education-bachelor-master-and-phd . 
  • Since the project is likely to involve extensive empirical research, dialogue with practitioners, meetings, and field-based data collection involving Norwegian and other Nordic actors, the ability to work effectively in Nordic industry and institutional contexts will be important. Relevant professional experience from industry or other practice-based settings in the Nordics, or in a comparable context, is therefore considered a strong merit. 
  • Oral and written English is required. Applicants from non-English speaking countries must document their English proficiency in accordance with the Supplementary Regulations for Admission to the PhD Programme at INN University. A command of a Scandinavian language is a strong merit. 
  • Expertise in relevant ICT software for research is an advantage. 
  • Research experience acquired after completion of the master’s degree is considered an advantage, but is not required. 
  • The candidate must be able to work independently and purposefully, and engage confidently with external actors to carry out empirical fieldwork. The role also requires the ability to collaborate well on academic research and publishing.

Evaluation of candidates for the position will be based on a total assessment of educational background, experience and personal suitability, as well as motivation and other eligibility requirements, as defined in the advertisement. In addition, the following will be emphasized: quality of the project description, documented independent research and development work or experience relevant to the project.

The position and associated tasks must be carried out in accordance with the applicable laws and regulations for government employees, including also the Act on Control of the Export of Strategic Goods, Services and Technology, etc. Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, come into conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to take up the position at University of Inland Norway. Necessary approvals must be maintained throughout the employment relationship.

How to apply

Relevant applications will be considered by an expert committee. The application and all attachments are to be submitted electronically and must include the following: 

  • The applicant must submit a project proposal with a progress plan (in Norwegian or English, 5-7 pages) that explains how the research work will be carried out and addresses academic relevance, challenges and possibilities within the project. The PhD research fellow hired will, in collaboration with a supervisor, prepare a complete project proposal creating the basis for admission to the PhD program. The project proposal plays an important part in evaluating applicants and must show how the project will lead to a successful completion of a doctoral degree within three years. 
  • Application letter 
  • CV (summarizing education, job positions, and academic work) 
  • Other work that is relevant for the application 
  • Certified copies of transcripts and diplomas for the whole bachelor and master’s degree. An English translation of all education documents is required unless the documents are in Norwegian/Scandinavian. 
  • Names and contact information of at least 2 reference persons. 
  • A copy of the master’s thesis (in PDF)

Attachments must be uploaded as separate files. If the attachments exceed 30 MB, they must be compressed prior to upload. It is the applicant's responsibility to ensure that all attachments are uploaded. Documents submitted after expiry of the deadline will not be considered in the evaluation of your application.

We offer
  • An academically stimulating and supportive work environment at a developing institution. 
  • Possibility of professional development in an exciting academic research environment. 
  • Position is paid and placed in position code PhD candidate 1017 in the Government Salary Scale. 
  • Membership in the Norwegian Public Service Pension, with among other things, good pension and insurance schemes.

For more information about INN University as an employer, please see here.

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F0FVnszhpJYGeneral information

INN believes that there is strength in inclusion and diversity. We desire employees with different competencies, professional combinations, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to an even better way of solving problems. We will facilitate for employees who need assitance to realise their goals. Relevant adaptations can be, for example, technical aids, adapting furniture or adjusting routines, work tasks and working hours.

If there are qualified applicants with disabilities, gaps in the CV or immigrant background, we shall call at least one applicant in each of these categories for an interview. In order to be considered as an applicant in these groups, the applicants must meet certain requirements. You can read more on this here: https://arbeidsgiver.difi.no/positivsaerbehandling.

We encourage applicants to tick in Jobbnorge if they have a disability, a gap in their CV or immigrant background. The ticks in the jobseeker portal form the basis for anonymised statistics that all state-owned enterprises report in their annual reports

Information about applicants may be made public even if the applicant has asked not to be named on the list of persons who have applied. The applicant must be notified if the request to be omitted is not met.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

University of Inland Norway is home to around 15,000 students and 1,450 employees. We have campuses in Lillehammer, Hamar, Elverum, Rena, Evenstad and Blæstad, and offer some courses at Kongsvinger and Tynset.

INN University is known for strong and enduring academic and research environments that will spearhead regionally, nationally and internationally.  

Our vision is "Stronger together - we build the university in an interdisciplinary community, together with the communities and the industries"

jobs.description: **Type**: Full-time, permanent**Location**: Malminkaari 21, 00700 Helsinki**Application deadline**: 26.10.2026Experienced with C#/.NET and React? Join Granlund to take ownership of a growing software platform and shape its future development!**What will you be doing?**Granlund is looking for a **Senior Full Stack Developer** to further develop its Design Data Management (DDM) platform. DDM transforms building information models into structured, usable data for cost, lifecycle, and 4D calculations. The platform is already in production, with new features and use cases actively being explored. Your work will help turn these opportunities into practical solutions for the construction and real estate industry.In this role, you will develop the DDM platform, focusing mainly on C#/.NET backend development and SQL Server, while also working with React and TypeScript on the frontend. You will develop new features end-to-end, improve existing functionality, and propose practical technical and architectural solutions. Your responsibilities will also include maintaining code quality through automated testing and controlled releases.You will collaborate with colleagues across different business areas to develop solutions that address real business needs. Beyond implementing new features, you will evaluate technical feasibility and help prioritize development efforts. Initially, your focus will include turning existing proofs of concept into usable features.**What makes you a great fit?**We are looking for an experienced developer who has a strong background in software development and actively uses AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor. You understand software architecture, can critically evaluate AI-generated code, and enjoy building software.You take ownership of your work and approach development with a practical, business-oriented mindset. You can assess business needs, identify what is worth developing, and suggest technical solutions that make sense. You also know when something is not worth implementing and can explain why.You are comfortable working independently in a small team and collaborating with others to make technical decisions. You don't need previous experience in construction or real estate; we welcome applications from developers across all industries.**We hope you have:**- Several years of backend development experience, ideally with C#/.NET, and strong SQL skills - Experience with React and TypeScript, and the ability to develop frontend features independently - A good understanding of software architecture, clean code, and automated testing - Hands-on experience building software with AI coding agents, and the judgement to review their output - Good communication skills in English or Finnish **We consider as an asset:**- Experience with Python and data processing tools, such as FastAPI, pandas, pyarrow, or IfcOpenShell - Experience working with large language models or developing AI-powered features - Familiarity with Azure services and CI/CD pipelines - Experience combining data from different sources into structured, usable information - Experience in product development, startups, or other environments requiring broad technical ownership. **What does Granlund offer you?**- An opportunity to take ownership of a growing software platform and directly influence its technical development. - Meaningful work turning complex building data into solutions that support smarter and more sustainable construction. - The freedom to shape technical solutions and see your ideas progress from early concepts into working features. - A small, collaborative team within an established company, with potential to grow into product or team leadership. - Flexible remote and hybrid working arrangements that allow you to combine independent development with in-person collaboration. - Comprehensive employee benefits, including occupational healthcare, sports and cultural benefits, and professional development opportunities. **Practicalities**This is a permanent, full-time position, and you will be employed directly by Granlund. The role offers flexible remote and hybrid working arrangements. Still, we hope you are based in the Helsinki metropolitan area or nearby to make it easier to meet in person for collaboration and workshops at Granlund's office in Malmi when needed. We hope you can start as soon as possible, but the exact start date is negotiable.Salary in this position is approximately 6000-8000 €/month. The final salary will be determined based on your experience and expertise. Granlund also offers a company-wide performance bonus scheme.**Recruitment process**- Remote interviews with aTalent - Two rounds of interviews with Granlund, conducted remotely and/or in person **Interested? We'd love to hear from you!**Submit your application and CV in PDF-format latest by the 26th of October via our application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/390936/create/.We review applications throughout the application period in the order they are received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we only accept applications through our recruitment system, not by email.We welcome applicants from different backgrounds and are committed to an inclusive recruitment process. We will accommodate individual accessibility needs whenever possible. You can learn more about Granlund at www.granlund.fi. For more information about the recruitment process contact aTalents Managing Recruitment Consultant Sofia Latva-Koivisto (+358 50 321 4473, sofia.latva-koivisto(at)atalent.fi). If Sofia is unable to answer your call, please leave a text message and she will get back to you.

jobs.title: social- og sundhedshjælperelev hos Carelink Pleje
jobs.description:
Bliv social- og sundhedshjælperelev hos Carelink Pleje

Carelink Pleje søger dig, der vil i gang med – eller allerede er i gang med – uddannelsen som social- og sundhedshjælper. Uddannelsen veksler mellem skole og praktik. Skoleperioderne foregår på den nærmeste Social- og Sundhedsskole i Midt- og Vestjylland. Der er også mulighed for at tage en del af uddannelsen/praktikken i udlandet via en tilknyttet arbejdsplads (kontakt os for mere info og links).

Hvorfor blive elev hos Carelink Pleje?

Siden Carelink Pleje blev etableret, har vores vision været at være det bedste valg inden for pleje og omsorg – også som arbejdsplads. Vores medarbejdere er forudsætningen for glade borgere og en sund organisation.

Det tilbyder vi

  • Spændende og lærerige opgaver og udfordringer

  • Engagerede vejledere og et stærkt fagligt læringsmiljø

  • Oplæringsplads og løn i hele uddannelsen

  • Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst

  • Voksenelevløn kan opnås efter fastlagte kriterier (ring og hør nærmere)

  • Mulighed for at prøve Carelink Plejes forskellige afdelinger i Aalborg og Jammerbugt Kommune

Hvad indebærer en elevplads?

Du får et praktikforløb, der dækker alle oplæringsmål for SOSU-hjælperuddannelsen:

  • Du tilknyttes en vejleder og får løbende råd, sparring og feedback

  • Du får grundig oplæring og følger en faglært medarbejder i praksis

  • Du lærer at udføre personlig pleje og omsorg på et fagligt højt niveau

  • Du øver dig i at være nysgerrig og observerende over for borgerens behov og ressourcer

  • Du opnår viden om rehabiliterende indsatser

  • Du oplever en organisation med kort vej mellem ledelse og medarbejdere

  • Du bliver en del af et godt fællesskab med kompetente kolleger

Vores forventninger til dig

  • Du er mødestabil, velsoigneret, venlig og imødekommende over for borgere og kolleger

  • Du når oplæringsforløbets mål under vejledning og deltager aktivt i fællesskabet

  • Du tager ansvar for din egen læring og deler viden med kolleger

  • Du taler, læser og forstår dansk på et middel højt niveau

  • Du har kørekort (B) og ren straffeattest.

Praktiske oplysninger

  • Elevstilling på 37 timer ugentligt

  • Uddannelsens varighed: Grundforløb 20 uger + SOSU-hjælperuddannelsen 14 måneder

  • Løn under uddannelse (uddannelsesaftale)

  • Weekend og aften arbejde kan variere i løbet af uddannelsen

  • Løbende opstart – Carelink Pleje følger skolernes skole-/oplæringsforløb

  • Mulighed for at starte som afløser/ufaglært inden uddannelsesstart

Ansøgning og kontakt

Send din ansøgning, CV og relevante bilag

Har du spørgsmål til uddannelsen, er du velkommen til at kontakte:

  • Driftschef Birthe Rex, på hverdage kl. 10.00–14.00, tlf. 98 180199

Vi læser ansøgninger og indkalder til samtaler løbende. Vi forbeholder os retten til at lukke opslaget, når de rette kandidater er fundet.

Såfremt du har spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte

Ansøgningsfrist:Løbende
